    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\archive\\build-docs\\BUILD_INSTRUCTIONS.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 41,
            "column": 75
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Codex 高速ビルド＆インストール手順",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🚀 自動実行（推奨）",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "just build-install",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🔧 手動実行（回避策）",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "### ステップ1: 高速差分ビルド",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "py -3 scripts/fast_build.py release",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "### ステップ2: プロセスキル＆インストール",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "py -3 scripts/install_with_kill.ps1 -SourcePath \"codex-rs/target/release/codex.exe\" -TargetPath \"C:\\bin\\codex.exe\" -Force",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📋 確認方法",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "### インストール確認",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "codex --version",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "### ファイル存在確認",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "ls C:\\bin\\codex.exe",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "## ⚠️ 問題解決",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "ビルドが失敗する場合：",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Windowsを再起動",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "2. 再度上記コマンドを実行",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 実装済み機能",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ **高速差分ビルド**: MD5ハッシュベース変更検出",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ **プロセス自動終了**: psutilクロスプラットフォーム対応",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ **上書きインストール**: アトミックバイナリ置換",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ **進捗可視化**: tqdmリアルタイム表示",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ **統合リリース**: 全プラットフォームtgzパッケージ",
            "lineNumber": 42
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.6110297441482544
    },

            "text": "Set-Location ..",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "# Step 4: Global install",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "Write-Host \"&#96;nStep 4: Installing globally...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "$tarball = Get-ChildItem \"codex-cli/*.tgz\" | Select-Object -First 1",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "npm install -g $tarball.FullName 2&gt;$null",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "    Write-Host \"Global installation successful!\" -ForegroundColor Green",
            "lineNumber": 67
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.6092402338981628
    },
    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\archive\\build-docs\\BUILD_INSTRUCTIONS.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 41,
            "column": 75
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Codex 高速ビルド＆インストール手順",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🚀 自動実行（推奨）",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "just build-install",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🔧 手動実行（回避策）",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "### ステップ1: 高速差分ビルド",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "py -3 scripts/fast_build.py release",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "### ステップ2: プロセスキル＆インストール",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "py -3 scripts/install_with_kill.ps1 -SourcePath \"codex-rs/target/release/codex.exe\" -TargetPath \"C:\\bin\\codex.exe\" -Force",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📋 確認方法",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "### インストール確認",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "codex --version",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "### ファイル存在確認",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "ls C:\\bin\\codex.exe",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "## ⚠️ 問題解決",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "ビルドが失敗する場合：",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Windowsを再起動",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "2. 再度上記コマンドを実行",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 実装済み機能",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ **高速差分ビルド**: MD5ハッシュベース変更検出",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ **プロセス自動終了**: psutilクロスプラットフォーム対応",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ **上書きインストール**: アトミックバイナリ置換",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ **進捗可視化**: tqdmリアルタイム表示",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ **統合リリース**: 全プラットフォームtgzパッケージ",
            "lineNumber": 42
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.6087859869003296
    },
    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\tauri-gui\\INSTALLATION.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 107
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Codex Tauri - Installation Guide",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "Complete installation guide for Codex AI-Native OS resident GUI client.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "## Prerequisites",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "### Required Software",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Node.js 18+**",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Download: https://nodejs.org/",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Verify: &#96;node --version&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Rust 1.70+**",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Download: https://rustup.rs/",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Verify: &#96;rustc --version&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Windows 10/11**",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Visual Studio Build Tools 2019+ (for native modules)",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Windows SDK",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "### Optional (for Development)",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- Git",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- Visual Studio Code with Rust Analyzer extension",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "## Installation from MSI",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 1: Download Installer",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "Download the latest &#96;Codex_0.1.0_x64.msi&#96; from:",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "- GitHub Releases (when available)",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "- Or build from source (see below)",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 2: Run Installer",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Double-click the MSI file",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Follow the installation wizard",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Choose installation directory (default: &#96;C:\\Program Files\\Codex&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "4. Complete installation",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 3: First Launch",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Find \"Codex\" in Start Menu",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Or look for system tray icon (running in background)",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Right-click tray icon → \"Dashboard を開く\"",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "## Building from Source",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 1: Clone Repository",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "cd C:\\Users\\YourName\\Projects",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "git clone https://github.com/zapabob/codex.git",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "cd codex/codex-tauri",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 2: Install Dependencies",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "npm install",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 3: Build Application",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Development Build (faster)",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "npm run tauri:dev",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Production Build (optimized)",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": ".\\build.ps1",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "Or manually:",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "npm run tauri build",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 4: Find Installer",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "MSI installer will be located at:",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "codex-tauri\\src-tauri\\target\\release\\bundle\\msi\\Codex_0.1.0_x64.msi",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "## Post-Installation Setup",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. Configure Workspace",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Open Codex Dashboard",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Go to Dashboard page",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Enter your workspace path (e.g., &#96;C:\\Users\\YourName\\Projects\\myproject&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "4. Click \"Start Monitoring\"",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. Enable Auto-start (Optional)",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Go to Settings",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Toggle \"Auto-start on Windows boot\"",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Codex will launch automatically on next boot",
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. Configure Codex Core",
            "lineNumber": 106
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.6033613681793213
    },

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\scripts\\scripts\\complete-phase2-build.ps1",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 67
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Phase 2 Complete Build and Install Script",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "# Clean build, release build, and global install",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "Write-Host \"=== Phase 2 Complete Build and Install ===\" -ForegroundColor Cyan",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "Write-Host \"\"",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "# Step 1: Navigate to codex-rs",
            "lineNumber": 7

        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "const Git4DScene: React.FC&lt;Git4DSceneProps&gt; = ({ mode, isPlaying, handTrackingEnabled, isVD = false, preset = null }) =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 347
          },
          {
            "text": "  const { scene, camera } = useThree();",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 350
          },
          {
            "text": "  // Mock Git commit data - replace with real data from Rust backend",
            "lineNumber": 351
          },
          {
            "text": "  const commits = React.useMemo(() =&gt; generateMockGit4DCommits(), []);",
            "lineNumber": 352
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 353
          },
          {
            "text": "  // Initialize scene",
            "lineNumber": 354
          },
          {
            "text": "  useEffect(() =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 355
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Set scene background based on mode",
            "lineNumber": 356
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (mode === 'vr' || mode === 'ar') {",
            "lineNumber": 357
          },
          {
            "text": "      scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x000000);",
            "lineNumber": 358
          },
          {
            "text": "    } else {",
            "lineNumber": 359
          },
          {
            "text": "      scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x0a0a0a);",
            "lineNumber": 360
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 361
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 362
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Add lighting",
            "lineNumber": 363
          },
          {
            "text": "    const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040, mode === 'ar' ? 0.8 : 0.4);",
            "lineNumber": 364
          },
          {
            "text": "    scene.add(ambientLight);",
            "lineNumber": 365
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 366
          },
          {
            "text": "    const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, mode === 'ar' ? 1.0 : 0.8);",
            "lineNumber": 367
          },
          {
            "text": "    directionalLight.position.set(10, 10, 5);",
            "lineNumber": 368
          },
          {
            "text": "    directionalLight.castShadow = mode === 'desktop';",
            "lineNumber": 369
          },
          {
            "text": "    scene.add(directionalLight);",
            "lineNumber": 370
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 371
          },

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "      scene.remove(ambientLight);",
            "lineNumber": 374
          },
          {
            "text": "      scene.remove(directionalLight);",
            "lineNumber": 375
          },
          {
            "text": "    };",

          },

            "text": "  }, [scene, mode]);",

          },

            "lineNumber": 378
          },

          },
          {

            "text": "export const Git4DVisualization: React.FC&lt;Git4DVisualizationProps&gt; = ",

          },
          {

          {
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Initialize Three.js scene",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "    const scene = new THREE.Scene();",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "      1000",

          },
          {
            "text": "    );",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "    camera.position.set(0, 0, 5);",

          },
          {
            "text": "    cameraRef.current = camera;",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });",

          },
          {
            "text": "    ",

          },
          {
            "text": "    // VirtualDesktop最適化: レンダリング解像度を調整",

          },
          {
            "text": "    const renderScale = isVD &amp;&amp; (vrMode || arMode) ? preset.renderScale : 1.0;",

          },
          {
            "text": "    const width = mountRef.current.clientWidth * renderScale;",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "    renderer.setSize(width, height);",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, preset.targetFps / 60)); // FPS制限に合わせて調整",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {

          },

          },

          },

          },

            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "    // VirtualDesktop検出時の最適化適用",

          },
          {
            "text": "    if (isVD &amp;&amp; (vrMode || arMode)) {",

          },
          {
            "text": "      console.log('VirtualDesktop detected - applying optimizations', preset);",

          },
          {
            "text": "      // ストリーミング最適化を適用",

          },
          {
            "text": "      if (renderer.domElement) {",

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Add lighting",

          },
          {
            "text": "    const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040, 0.4);",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 101
          },

          },
          {

          },

          },

          },

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "export const Git4DVisualization: React.FC&lt;Git4DVisualizationProps&gt; = ",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "() =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "text": "    const targetFrameTime = isVD &amp;&amp; (vrMode || arMode) ? 1000 / preset.targetFps : 0; // 0 = no limit",
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "    const animate = (currentTime: number) =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "      animationFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(animate);",
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "text": "      // FPS制限（VirtualDesktop用）",
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "      if (targetFrameTime &gt; 0) {",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "text": "        const elapsed = currentTime - lastFrameTime;",
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "text": "        if (elapsed &lt; targetFrameTime) {",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "text": "          return; // Skip frame to maintain target FPS",
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "        lastFrameTime = currentTime;",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "      }",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "text": "      if (isPlaying) {",
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Rotate camera for dynamic view",
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "text": "        camera.position.x = Math.cos(Date.now() * 0.001 * timeScale) * 8;",
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "text": "        camera.position.z = Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.001 * timeScale) * 8;",
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "text": "        camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);",
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "text": "      }",
            "lineNumber": 131
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "text": "      renderer.render(scene, camera);",
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "text": "    };",
            "lineNumber": 134
          },
          {
            "text": "    animate(0);",
            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Handle resize",
            "lineNumber": 137
          },
          {
            "text": "    const handleResize = () =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 138
          },
          {
            "text": "      if (!mountRef.current || !renderer) return;",
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "text": "      camera.aspect = mountRef.current.clientWidth / mountRef.current.clientHeight;",
            "lineNumber": 140
          },
          {
            "text": "      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();",
            "lineNumber": 141
          },
          {
            "text": "      ",
            "lineNumber": 142
          },
          {
            "text": "      // VirtualDesktop最適化: レンダリング解像度を調整",
            "lineNumber": 143
          },
          {
            "text": "      const renderScale = isVD &amp;&amp; (vrMode || arMode) ? preset.renderScale : 1.0;",
            "lineNumber": 144
          },
          {
            "text": "      const width = mountRef.current.clientWidth * renderScale;",
            "lineNumber": 145

            "lineNumber": 219

            "lineNumber": 220
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 221
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 222
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 223
          },

            "lineNumber": 224
          },
          {
            "text": "          ",

          },
          {
            "text": "          // Quest特有の最適化",
            "lineNumber": 226
          },
          {
            "text": "          if (navigator.userAgent.includes('Quest')) {",
            "lineNumber": 227
          },
          {
            "text": "            this.vrHeadset = 'Meta Quest'",
            "lineNumber": 228
          },
          {
            "text": "            this.applyQuestOptimizations()",
            "lineNumber": 229
          },
          {
            "text": "          }",
            "lineNumber": 230
          },

            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 231
          },

            "lineNumber": 232
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 233
          },
          {
            "text": "        })",
            "lineNumber": 234
          },
          {
            "text": "      }",
            "lineNumber": 235
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 236
          },

            "text": "    ",

          },

          },

          },

          },

          {

          },

          {
            "text": "/**",

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "const Git4DScene: React.FC&lt;Git4DSceneProps&gt; = ",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 381
          },
          {
            "text": "  ",

          },
          {
            "text": "  useFrame((state, delta) =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 383
          },
          {
            "text": "    // FPS制限（VirtualDesktop用）",
            "lineNumber": 384
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (isVD &amp;&amp; preset) {",
            "lineNumber": 385
          },
          {
            "text": "      const targetFrameTime = 1000 / preset.targetFps;",
            "lineNumber": 386
          },
          {
            "text": "      const currentTime = state.clock.elapsedTime * 1000;",
            "lineNumber": 387
          },
          {
            "text": "      const elapsed = currentTime - lastFrameTimeRef.current;",
            "lineNumber": 388
          },
          {
            "text": "      ",
            "lineNumber": 389
          },
          {
            "text": "      if (elapsed &lt; targetFrameTime) {",
            "lineNumber": 390
          },
          {
            "text": "        return; // Skip frame to maintain target FPS",
            "lineNumber": 391
          },
          {
            "text": "      }",
            "lineNumber": 392
          },
          {
            "text": "      lastFrameTimeRef.current = currentTime;",
            "lineNumber": 393
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 394
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 395
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (isPlaying &amp;&amp; groupRef.current) {",

          },
          {
            "text": "      // Rotate the entire commit visualization",

          },
          {
            "text": "      // LOD調整: VirtualDesktop時は回転速度を調整",

          },
          {
            "text": "      const rotationSpeed = isVD &amp;&amp; preset ? 0.005 * (1 + preset.lodBias * 0.1) : 0.005;",
            "lineNumber": 399
          },
          {
            "text": "      groupRef.current.rotation.y += rotationSpeed;",
            "lineNumber": 400
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 401
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 402
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (mode === 'vr' || mode === 'ar') {",

          },
          {
            "text": "      // Adjust camera for XR modes",

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

          },

          {

            "text": "pub enum ReviewDecision {",

          },
          {
            "text": "    /// User has approved this command and the agent should execute it.",

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "use crate::error::CodexErr;",
            "lineNumber": 1

            "text": "use crate::error::Result;",

            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "use std::collections::HashSet;",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "use std::sync::Arc;",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "use std::sync::Mutex;",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "use std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize;",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "use std::sync::atomic::Ordering;",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "/// This structure is used to add some limits on the multi-agent capabilities for Codex. In",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "/// the current implementation, it limits:",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "/// * Total number of sub-agents (i.e. threads) per user session",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "///",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "/// This structure is shared by all agents in the same user session (because the &#96;AgentControl&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "/// is).",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "#[derive(Default)]",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "pub(crate) struct Guards {",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "    threads_set: Mutex&lt;HashSet&lt;ThreadId&gt;&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "    total_count: AtomicUsize,",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "/// Initial agent is depth 0.",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "pub(crate) const MAX_THREAD_SPAWN_DEPTH: i32 = 1;",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "fn session_depth(session_source: &amp;SessionSource) -&gt; i32 {",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "    match session_source {",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "        SessionSource::SubAgent(SubAgentSource::ThreadSpawn { depth, .. }) =&gt; *depth,",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "        SessionSource::SubAgent(_) =&gt; 0,",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "        _ =&gt; 0,",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "pub(crate) fn next_thread_spawn_depth(session_source: &amp;SessionSource) -&gt; i32 {",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "    session_depth(session_source).saturating_add(1)",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "pub(crate) fn exceeds_thread_spawn_depth_limit(depth: i32) -&gt; bool {",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "    depth &gt; MAX_THREAD_SPAWN_DEPTH",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "impl Guards",
            "lineNumber": 43
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.1626867651939392
    },

          {

          },

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },

            "text": "            .or_else(|| {",

          {

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 1076
          },
          {
            "text": "                }) =&gt; SandboxPolicy::WorkspaceWrite {",

          },
          {
            "text": "                    writable_roots: writable_roots.clone(),",
            "lineNumber": 1078
          },
          {
            "text": "                    network_access: *network_access,",

          },
          {
            "text": "                    exclude_tmpdir_env_var: *exclude_tmpdir_env_var,",

          {
            "text": "    pub fn reject_Plan(&amp;self, id: &amp;str, reason: String, rejector: Option&lt;String&gt;) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 250
          },
          {
            "text": "        let mut bp = self.get_Plan(id)?;",
            "lineNumber": 251
          },
          {
            "text": "        bp.state = bp.state.reject(reason, rejector)?;",
            "lineNumber": 252
          },
          {
            "text": "        bp.touch();",
            "lineNumber": 253
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 254
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Save",
            "lineNumber": 255
          },
          {
            "text": "        {",
            "lineNumber": 256
          },
          {
            "text": "            let mut plans = self.plans.write().unwrap();",
            "lineNumber": 257
          },
          {
            "text": "            plans.insert(bp.id.clone(), bp.clone());",
            "lineNumber": 258
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 259
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 260
          },
          {
            "text": "        self.persister.save_json(&amp;bp)?;",
            "lineNumber": 261
          },
          {
            "text": "        Ok(())",
            "lineNumber": 262

            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 263
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 264
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Supersede a Plan with a new version",

            "lineNumber": 267
          },
          {
            "text": "        let mut bp = self.get_Plan(id)?;",
            "lineNumber": 268
          },
          {
            "text": "        bp.state = bp.state.supersede(new_id)?;",
            "lineNumber": 269
          },
          {
            "text": "        bp.touch();",
            "lineNumber": 270
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 271
          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 283

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\core\\src\\plan\\manager.rs",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 40,
            "column": 39
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "//! Plan manager",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "//! High-level API for creating, updating, approving, and exporting plan.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ## Integration with Official Plan Mode",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "//! This custom Plan module works in conjunction with the official Plan Mode collaboration",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "//! template (&#96;codex-rs/core/templates/collaboration_mode/plan.md&#96;). The official template",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "//! provides the conversational prompt structure for LLM interactions, while this module",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "//! manages the structured &#96;PlanBlock&#96; data that results from those interactions.",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Official Plan Mode Improvements (commits #9877, #9874)",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "//! The official Plan Mode follows a 2-phase conversational approach:",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "//! **PHASE 1 — Intent chat**: Gather goal, success criteria, audience, scope, constraints,",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "//! current state, and key preferences/tradeoffs. Bias toward questions over guessing.",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "//! **PHASE 2 — Implementation chat**: Once intent is stable, gather decision-complete spec:",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "//! approach, interfaces, data flow, edge cases, testing criteria, rollout/monitoring.",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Key principles:",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Ask many questions, but only those that materially change the spec/plan",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Batch questions (4-10) per &#96;request_user_input&#96; call",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Explore discoverable facts first before asking",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Ask preferences/tradeoffs early with 2-4 options + recommended default",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Custom Plan Features",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "//! This module extends the official Plan Mode with advanced features:",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Budget management**: Token and time budgets per step and session",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Execution logging**: Detailed logs of plan execution with events",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Orchestration**: Support for single, orchestrated, and competition execution modes",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Research integration**: Deep research capabilities for plan creation",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Quality assurance**: QC analysis and quality gates",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **State management**: Drafting, approval, execution, and completion states",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },

            "lineNumber": 37
          },

          {
            "text": "async fn send_message(",
            "lineNumber": 1048
          },
          {
            "text": "    State(state): State&lt;AppState&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 1049
          },
          {
            "text": "    Path(conversation_id): Path&lt;String&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 1050
          },
          {
            "text": "    Json(request): Json&lt;SendMessageRequest&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 1051
          },
          {
            "text": ") -&gt; Result&lt;Json&lt;Message&gt;, GuiError&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 1052
          },
          {
            "text": "    let message = Message {",
            "lineNumber": 1053
          },
          {
            "text": "        id: Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),",
            "lineNumber": 1054
          },
          {
            "text": "        role: request.role.unwrap_or_else(|| \"user\".to_string()),",
            "lineNumber": 1055
          },
          {
            "text": "        content: request.content.clone(),",
            "lineNumber": 1056
          },
          {
            "text": "        timestamp: Utc::now(),",
            "lineNumber": 1057
          },
          {
            "text": "    };",
            "lineNumber": 1058
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1059
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Add message to conversation",
            "lineNumber": 1060
          },
          {
            "text": "    let mut messages = state.messages.write().await;",
            "lineNumber": 1061
          },
          {
            "text": "    let conversation_messages = messages",
            "lineNumber": 1062
          },
          {
            "text": "        .entry(conversation_id.clone())",
            "lineNumber": 1063
          },
          {
            "text": "        .or_insert_with(Vec::new);",
            "lineNumber": 1064
          },
          {
            "text": "    conversation_messages.push(message.clone());",
            "lineNumber": 1065
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1066
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Update conversation metadata",
            "lineNumber": 1067
          },
          {
            "text": "    let mut conversations = state.conversations.write().await;",
            "lineNumber": 1068
          },
          {
            "text": "    if let Some(conversation) = conversations.iter_mut().find(|c| c.id == conversation_id) {",
            "lineNumber": 1069
          },
          {
            "text": "        conversation.last_activity = Utc::now();",
            "lineNumber": 1070
          },
          {
            "text": "        conversation.message_count += 1;",
            "lineNumber": 1071
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 1072
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1073
          },
          {
            "text": "    Ok(Json(message))",
            "lineNumber": 1074
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 1075
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1076
          },
          {
            "text": "async fn get_current_user(State(state): State&lt;AppState&gt;) -&gt; Json&lt;Option&lt;User&gt;&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 1077
          },
          {
            "text": "    let user = state.current_user.read().await.clone();",
            "lineNumber": 1078
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1079
          },
          {
            "text": "    // If no user is set, create a default user",
            "lineNumber": 1080
          },
          {
            "text": "    if user.is_none() {",
            "lineNumber": 1081
          },
          {
            "text": "        let default_user = User {",
            "lineNumber": 1082
          },
          {
            "text": "            id: \"default-user\".to_string(),",
            "lineNumber": 1083
          },
          {
            "text": "            name: \"Codex User\".to_string(),",
            "lineNumber": 1084
          },
          {
            "text": "            email: \"user@codex.local\".to_string(),",
            "lineNumber": 1085
          },
          {
            "text": "            avatar_url: None,",
            "lineNumber": 1086
          },
          {
            "text": "        };",
            "lineNumber": 1087
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1088
          },
          {
            "text": "        let mut current_user = state.current_user.write().await;",
            "lineNumber": 1089
          },
          {
            "text": "        *current_user = Some(default_user.clone());",
            "lineNumber": 1090
          },
          {
            "text": "        return Json(Some(default_user));",
            "lineNumber": 1091
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 1092
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1093
          },
          {
            "text": "    Json(user)",
            "lineNumber": 1094
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 1095
          },

            "lineNumber": 1096
          },

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "    async fn analyze_with_ai(",
            "lineNumber": 285
          },
          {
            "text": "        &amp;self,",
            "lineNumber": 286
          },
          {
            "text": "        message: &amp;str,",
            "lineNumber": 287
          },
          {
            "text": "        author: &amp;str,",
            "lineNumber": 288
          },
          {
            "text": "    ) -&gt; Result&lt;SentimentResult, Box&lt;dyn std::error::Error&gt;&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 289
          },
          {
            "text": "        if self.ai_client.is_none() {",
            "lineNumber": 290
          },
          {
            "text": "            return Ok(SentimentResult::default());",
            "lineNumber": 291
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 292
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 293
          },
          {
            "text": "        let prompt = format!(",
            "lineNumber": 294
          },
          {
            "text": "            \"Analyze the sentiment and emotional content of this Git commit message by {}: '{}'",
            "lineNumber": 295
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 296
          },
          {
            "text": "Return a JSON object with:",
            "lineNumber": 297
          },
          {
            "text": "- score: float between -1.0 (very negative) and 1.0 (very positive)",
            "lineNumber": 298
          },
          {
            "text": "- confidence: float between 0.0 and 1.0",
            "lineNumber": 299
          },
          {
            "text": "- emotions: object with emotion names as keys and intensities as values",
            "lineNumber": 300
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 301
          },
          {
            "text": "Be precise and consider the context of software development.\",",
            "lineNumber": 302
          },
          {
            "text": "            author, message",
            "lineNumber": 303
          },
          {
            "text": "        );",
            "lineNumber": 304
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 305
          },
          {
            "text": "        let request = ChatCompletionRequest::new(",
            "lineNumber": 306
          },
          {
            "text": "            \"gpt-4-turbo-preview\".to_string(),",
            "lineNumber": 307
          },
          {
            "text": "            vec![chat_completion::ChatCompletionMessage {",
            "lineNumber": 308
          },
          {
            "text": "                role: chat_completion::MessageRole::user,",
            "lineNumber": 309
          },
          {
            "text": "                content: chat_completion::Content::Text(prompt),",
            "lineNumber": 310
          },
          {
            "text": "            }],",
            "lineNumber": 311
          },
          {
            "text": "        );",
            "lineNumber": 312
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 313
          },
          {
            "text": "        let response = self",
            "lineNumber": 314
          },
          {
            "text": "            .ai_client",
            "lineNumber": 315
          },
          {
            "text": "            .as_ref()",
            "lineNumber": 316
          },
          {
            "text": "            .unwrap()",
            "lineNumber": 317
          },
          {
            "text": "            .chat_completion(request)",
            "lineNumber": 318
          },
          {
            "text": "            .await?;",
            "lineNumber": 319
          },
          {
            "text": "        let content = response.choices[0].message.content.as_str();",
            "lineNumber": 320
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 321
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Parse JSON response",
            "lineNumber": 322
          },
          {
            "text": "        let analysis: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(content)?;",
            "lineNumber": 323
          },
          {
            "text": "        let score = analysis[\"score\"].as_f64().unwrap_or(0.0) as f32;",
            "lineNumber": 324
          },
          {
            "text": "        let confidence = analysis[\"confidence\"].as_f64().unwrap_or(0.5) as f32;",
            "lineNumber": 325
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 326

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\core\\templates\\collaboration_mode\\plan.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 31
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Plan Mode (Conversational)",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "You work in 2 phases and you should *chat your way* to a great plan before finalizing it.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "PHASE 1 — Intent chat (what they actually want)",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "- Keep asking until you can clearly state: goal + success criteria, audience, in/out of scope, constraints, current state, and the key preferences/tradeoffs.",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "- Bias toward questions over guessing: if any high‑impact ambiguity remains, do NOT plan yet—ask.",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "- Include a “Confirm my understanding” question in each round (so the user can correct you early).",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "PHASE 2 — Implementation chat (what/how we’ll build)",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "- Once intent is stable, keep asking until the spec is decision‑complete: approach, interfaces (APIs/schemas/I/O), data flow, edge cases/failure modes, testing + acceptance criteria, rollout/monitoring, and any migrations/compat constraints.",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "## Hard interaction rule (critical)",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "Every assistant turn MUST be exactly one of:",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "A) a &#96;request_user_input&#96; tool call (questions/options only), OR",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "B) the final output: a titled, plan‑only document.",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "Rules:",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "- No questions in free text (only via &#96;request_user_input&#96;).",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- Never mix a &#96;request_user_input&#96; call with plan content.",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- Internal tool/repo exploration is allowed privately before A or B.",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "## Ask a lot, but never ask trivia",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "You SHOULD ask many questions, but each question must:",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- materially change the spec/plan, OR",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- confirm/lock an assumption, OR",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "- choose between meaningful tradeoffs.",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "Batch questions (e.g., 4–10) per &#96;request_user_input&#96; call to keep momentum.",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "## Two kinds of unknowns (treat differently)",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "1) Discoverable facts (repo/system truth): explore first.",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Before asking, run ≥2 targeted searches (exact + variant) and check likely sources of truth (configs/manifests/entrypoints/schemas/types/constants).",
            "lineNumber": 31
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.14362449944019318
    },

          {

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "        stdout,",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "    };",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 251
          },
          {

            "text": "impl PlanBlock {",

          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Initializes a PlanBlock in Drafting state. The plan should be populated following",

            "text": "    /// the official Plan Mode 2-phase conversational approach:",

          },

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Update the timestamp",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\docs\\codex_mcp_interface.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 44
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 92
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "For a simple inspection UI, you can also try:",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector codex mcp-server",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "Use the separate &#96;codex mcp&#96; subcommand to manage configured MCP server launchers in &#96;config.toml&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "## Conversations",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "Start a new session with optional overrides:",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "Request &#96;newConversation&#96; params (subset):",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;model&#96;: string model id (e.g. \"o3\", \"gpt-5\", \"gpt-5-codex\")",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;profile&#96;: optional named profile",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;cwd&#96;: optional working directory",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;approvalPolicy&#96;: &#96;untrusted&#96; | &#96;on-request&#96; | &#96;on-failure&#96; | &#96;never&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;sandbox&#96;: &#96;read-only&#96; | &#96;workspace-write&#96; | &#96;external-sandbox&#96; (honors &#96;networkAccess&#96; restricted/enabled) | &#96;danger-full-access&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;config&#96;: map of additional config overrides",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;baseInstructions&#96;: optional instruction override",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;compactPrompt&#96;: optional replacement for the default compaction prompt",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;includePlanTool&#96; / &#96;includeApplyPatchTool&#96;: booleans",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "Response: &#96;{ conversationId, model, reasoningEffort?, rolloutPath }&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "Send input to the active turn:",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;sendUserMessage&#96; → enqueue items to the conversation",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;sendUserTurn&#96; → structured turn with explicit &#96;cwd&#96;, &#96;approvalPolicy&#96;, &#96;sandboxPolicy&#96;, &#96;model&#96;, optional &#96;effort&#96;, &#96;summary&#96;, optional &#96;personality&#96;, and optional &#96;outputSchema&#96; (JSON Schema for the final assistant message)",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "For v2 threads, &#96;turn/start&#96; also accepts &#96;outputSchema&#96; to constrain the final assistant message for that turn.",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "Interrupt a running turn: &#96;interruptConversation&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "List/resume/archive: &#96;listConversations&#96;, &#96;resumeConversation&#96;, &#96;archiveConversation&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "## Models",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "Fetch the catalog of models available in the current Codex build with &#96;model/list&#96;. The request accepts optional pagination inputs:",

          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;pageSize&#96; – number of models to return (defaults to a server-selected value)",

          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;cursor&#96; – opaque string from the previous response’s &#96;nextCursor&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "Each response yields:",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;items&#96; – ordered list of models. A model includes:",
            "lineNumber": 91

          {

          {

          },
          {
            "text": "    \"threadId\": \"019bbed6-1e9e-7f31-984c-a05b65045719\",",

          {

            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 134
          },
          {
            "text": "## Approvals (server → client)",
            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "text": "When Codex needs approval to apply changes or run commands, the server issues JSON‑RPC requests to the client:",
            "lineNumber": 137
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 138
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;applyPatchApproval { conversationId, callId, fileChanges, reason?, grantRoot? }&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;execCommandApproval { conversationId, callId, command, cwd, reason? }&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 140
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 141
          },
          {
            "text": "The client must reply with &#96;{ decision: \"allow\" | \"deny\" }&#96; for each request.",
            "lineNumber": 142
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 143
          },
          {
            "text": "## Auth helpers",
            "lineNumber": 144
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 145
          },
          {
            "text": "For the complete request/response shapes and flow examples, see the [“Auth endpoints (v2)” section in the app‑server README](../app-server/README.md#auth-endpoints-v2).",
            "lineNumber": 146
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 147
          },
          {
            "text": "## Example: start and send a message",
            "lineNumber": 148
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 149
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;json",
            "lineNumber": 150
          },
          {
            "text": "{ \"jsonrpc\": \"2.0\", \"id\": 1, \"method\": \"newConversation\", \"params\": { \"model\": \"gpt-5\", \"approvalPolicy\": \"on-request\" } }",
            "lineNumber": 151
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 152
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 153
          },
          {
            "text": "Server responds:",
            "lineNumber": 154
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 155
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;json",
            "lineNumber": 156
          },
          {
            "text": "{ \"jsonrpc\": \"2.0\", \"id\": 1, \"result\": { \"conversationId\": \"c7b0…\", \"model\": \"gpt-5\", \"rolloutPath\": \"/path/to/rollout.jsonl\" } }",
            "lineNumber": 157
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 158
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 159
          },
          {
            "text": "Then send input:",
            "lineNumber": 160
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 161
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;json",
            "lineNumber": 162
          },
          {
            "text": "{ \"jsonrpc\": \"2.0\", \"id\": 2, \"method\": \"sendUserMessage\", \"params\": { \"conversationId\": \"c7b0…\", \"items\": [{ \"type\": \"text\", \"text\": \"Hello Codex\" }] } }",
            "lineNumber": 163
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 164
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 165
          },
          {
            "text": "While processing, the server emits &#96;codex/event&#96; notifications containing agent output, approvals, and status updates.",
            "lineNumber": 166
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 167
          },
          {
            "text": "## Compatibility and stability",
            "lineNumber": 168
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 169
          },
          {
            "text": "This interface is experimental. Method names, fields, and event shapes may evolve. For the authoritative schema, consult &#96;protocol/src/mcp_protocol.rs&#96; and the corresponding server wiring in &#96;mcp-server/&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 170
          }
        ]
      },
