        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "//! Plan manager",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "//! High-level API for creating, updating, approving, and exporting plan.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ## Integration with Official Plan Mode",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "//! This custom Plan module works in conjunction with the official Plan Mode collaboration",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "//! template (&#96;codex-rs/core/templates/collaboration_mode/plan.md&#96;). The official template",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "//! provides the conversational prompt structure for LLM interactions, while this module",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "//! manages the structured &#96;PlanBlock&#96; data that results from those interactions.",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Official Plan Mode Improvements (commits #9877, #9874)",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "//! The official Plan Mode follows a 2-phase conversational approach:",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "//! **PHASE 1 — Intent chat**: Gather goal, success criteria, audience, scope, constraints,",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "//! current state, and key preferences/tradeoffs. Bias toward questions over guessing.",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "//! **PHASE 2 — Implementation chat**: Once intent is stable, gather decision-complete spec:",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "//! approach, interfaces, data flow, edge cases, testing criteria, rollout/monitoring.",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Key principles:",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Ask many questions, but only those that materially change the spec/plan",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Batch questions (4-10) per &#96;request_user_input&#96; call",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Explore discoverable facts first before asking",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Ask preferences/tradeoffs early with 2-4 options + recommended default",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Custom Plan Features",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "//! This module extends the official Plan Mode with advanced features:",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Budget management**: Token and time budgets per step and session",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Execution logging**: Detailed logs of plan execution with events",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Orchestration**: Support for single, orchestrated, and competition execution modes",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Research integration**: Deep research capabilities for plan creation",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Quality assurance**: QC analysis and quality gates",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **State management**: Drafting, approval, execution, and completion states",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "use super::persist::PlanPersister;",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "use super::policy::ApprovalRole;",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "use super::policy::PolicyEnforcer;",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "use super::policy::PrivilegedOperation;",
            "lineNumber": 41
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.1871808022260666
    }
  ]
}

            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "/// the current implementation, it limits:",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "/// * Total number of sub-agents (i.e. threads) per user session",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "///",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "/// This structure is shared by all agents in the same user session (because the &#96;AgentControl&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "/// is).",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "#[derive(Default)]",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "pub(crate) struct Guards {",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "    threads_set: Mutex&lt;HashSet&lt;ThreadId&gt;&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "    total_count: AtomicUsize,",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "/// Initial agent is depth 0.",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "pub(crate) const MAX_THREAD_SPAWN_DEPTH: i32 = 1;",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "fn session_depth(session_source: &amp;SessionSource) -&gt; i32 {",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "    match session_source {",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "        SessionSource::SubAgent(SubAgentSource::ThreadSpawn { depth, .. }) =&gt; *depth,",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "        SessionSource::SubAgent(_) =&gt; 0,",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "        _ =&gt; 0,",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "pub(crate) fn next_thread_spawn_depth(session_source: &amp;SessionSource) -&gt; i32 {",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "    session_depth(session_source).saturating_add(1)",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "pub(crate) fn exceeds_thread_spawn_depth_limit(depth: i32) -&gt; bool {",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "    depth &gt; MAX_THREAD_SPAWN_DEPTH",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "impl Guards",
            "lineNumber": 43
          }
        ]
      },

            "text": "    pub fn reject_Plan(&amp;self, id: &amp;str, reason: String, rejector: Option&lt;String&gt;) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {",

            "lineNumber": 252
          },
          {
            "text": "        bp.touch();",
            "lineNumber": 253
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 254
          },

          },

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\core\\src\\plan\\manager.rs",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 40,
            "column": 39
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "//! Plan manager",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "//! High-level API for creating, updating, approving, and exporting plan.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ## Integration with Official Plan Mode",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "//! This custom Plan module works in conjunction with the official Plan Mode collaboration",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "//! template (&#96;codex-rs/core/templates/collaboration_mode/plan.md&#96;). The official template",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "//! provides the conversational prompt structure for LLM interactions, while this module",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "//! manages the structured &#96;PlanBlock&#96; data that results from those interactions.",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Official Plan Mode Improvements (commits #9877, #9874)",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "//! The official Plan Mode follows a 2-phase conversational approach:",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "//! **PHASE 1 — Intent chat**: Gather goal, success criteria, audience, scope, constraints,",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "//! current state, and key preferences/tradeoffs. Bias toward questions over guessing.",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "//! **PHASE 2 — Implementation chat**: Once intent is stable, gather decision-complete spec:",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "//! approach, interfaces, data flow, edge cases, testing criteria, rollout/monitoring.",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Key principles:",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Ask many questions, but only those that materially change the spec/plan",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Batch questions (4-10) per &#96;request_user_input&#96; call",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Explore discoverable facts first before asking",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Ask preferences/tradeoffs early with 2-4 options + recommended default",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Custom Plan Features",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "//! This module extends the official Plan Mode with advanced features:",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Budget management**: Token and time budgets per step and session",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Execution logging**: Detailed logs of plan execution with events",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Orchestration**: Support for single, orchestrated, and competition execution modes",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Research integration**: Deep research capabilities for plan creation",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Quality assurance**: QC analysis and quality gates",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **State management**: Drafting, approval, execution, and completion states",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "use super::persist::PlanPersister;",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "use super::policy::ApprovalRole;",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "use super::policy::PolicyEnforcer;",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "use super::policy::PrivilegedOperation;",
            "lineNumber": 41
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.15719319880008698
    },
    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\core\\src\\plan\\mod.rs",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 43
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "//! plan mode implementation",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Provides read-only planning phase with approval gates, budget enforcement,",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "//! and multiple execution strategies (single, orchestrated, competition).",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ## Integration with Official Plan Mode",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "//! This custom Plan module extends the official Plan Mode collaboration template",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "//! (&#96;codex-rs/core/templates/collaboration_mode/plan.md&#96;) with advanced features",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "//! while maintaining alignment with the official 2-phase conversational approach.",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Official Plan Mode Structure",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "//! The official Plan Mode (improved in commits #9877, #9874) uses a conversational",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "//! 2-phase approach:",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "//! 1. **PHASE 1 — Intent chat**: Understand what the user actually wants",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Goal + success criteria, audience, in/out of scope, constraints, current state",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Key preferences/tradeoffs",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Bias toward questions over guessing",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "//! 2. **PHASE 2 — Implementation chat**: Technical spec and implementation plan",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Approach, interfaces (APIs/schemas/I/O), data flow",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Edge cases/failure modes, testing + acceptance criteria",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Rollout/monitoring, migrations/compat constraints",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Key Principles from Official Improvements",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Ask a lot, but never ask trivia**: Questions must materially change the spec/plan,",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "//!   confirm/lock assumptions, or choose between meaningful tradeoffs",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Batch questions**: 4-10 questions per &#96;request_user_input&#96; call to keep momentum",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Two kinds of unknowns**:",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "//!   1. Discoverable facts: Explore first (≥2 targeted searches) before asking",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "//!   2. Preferences/tradeoffs: Ask early with 2-4 options + recommended default",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Finalization rule**: Only output final plan when remaining unknowns are low-impact",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "//!   and explicitly listed as assumptions",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Custom Plan Features",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "//! This module adds advanced capabilities beyond the official template:",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Budget management**: Token and time budgets with per-step and session caps",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Execution logging**: Detailed event-based logs of plan execution",
            "lineNumber": 43
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.1546788066625595
    },

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "//! Plan schema definitions",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Defines the core data structures for plan mode, including the",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "//! PlanBlock which represents a complete planning artifact.",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ## Alignment with Official Plan Mode",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "//! The &#96;PlanBlock&#96; structure captures the structured output from the official Plan Mode",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "//! collaboration template. Key fields align with the 2-phase approach:",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Phase 1 (Intent)**: &#96;goal&#96;, &#96;assumptions&#96;, &#96;clarifying_questions&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Phase 2 (Implementation)**: &#96;approach&#96;, &#96;work_items&#96;, &#96;risks&#96;, &#96;eval&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "//! The &#96;clarifying_questions&#96; field should contain questions that:",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Materially change the spec/plan, OR",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Confirm/lock an assumption, OR",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Choose between meaningful tradeoffs",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Questions should be batched (4-10 per interaction) to maintain momentum, following",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "//! the official Plan Mode improvements from commits #9877 and #9874.",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "use chrono::DateTime;",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "use chrono::Utc;",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "use serde::Deserialize;",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "use serde::Serialize;",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "use std::collections::HashMap;",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "/// Execution mode for Plan execution",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "#[serde(rename_all = \"snake_case\")]",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "pub enum ExecutionMode {",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Single agent, no orchestration",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "    Single,",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Orchestrated control with central planner + sub-agents",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "    Orchestrated,",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Worktree competition with multiple variants",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "    Competition,",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "impl Default for ExecutionMode {",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "    fn default() -&gt; Self {",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "        Self::Orchestrated",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "impl std::fmt::Display for ExecutionMode {",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "    fn fmt(&amp;self, f: &amp;mut std::fmt::Formatter&lt;'_&gt;) -&gt; std::fmt::Result {",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "        match self {",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "            Self::Single =&gt; write!(f, \"single\"),",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "            Self::Orchestrated =&gt; write!(f, \"orchestrated\"),",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "            Self::Competition =&gt; write!(f, \"competition\"),",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "/// A single work item in the Plan",

          },
          {
            "text": "#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "pub struct WorkItem {",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Work item name",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub name: String,",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Files that will be touched",
            "lineNumber": 61
          }
        ]
      },

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "use crate::error::CodexErr;",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "use crate::error::Result;",

          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_protocol::ThreadId;",

          },

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "use std::sync::Arc;",

          },
          {
            "text": "use std::sync::Mutex;",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "/// This structure is used to add some limits on the multi-agent capabilities for Codex. In",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "/// the current implementation, it limits:",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "/// * Total number of sub-agents (i.e. threads) per user session",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "///",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "/// This structure is shared by all agents in the same user session (because the &#96;AgentControl&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "/// is).",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "#[derive(Default)]",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "pub(crate) struct Guards {",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "    threads_set: Mutex&lt;HashSet&lt;ThreadId&gt;&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "    total_count: AtomicUsize,",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "/// Initial agent is depth 0.",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "pub(crate) const MAX_THREAD_SPAWN_DEPTH: i32 = 1;",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "fn session_depth(session_source: &amp;SessionSource) -&gt; i32 {",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "    match session_source {",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "        SessionSource::SubAgent(SubAgentSource::ThreadSpawn { depth, .. }) =&gt; *depth,",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "        SessionSource::SubAgent(_) =&gt; 0,",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "        _ =&gt; 0,",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "pub(crate) fn next_thread_spawn_depth(session_source: &amp;SessionSource) -&gt; i32 {",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "    session_depth(session_source).saturating_add(1)",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "pub(crate) fn exceeds_thread_spawn_depth_limit(depth: i32) -&gt; bool {",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "    depth &gt; MAX_THREAD_SPAWN_DEPTH",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "impl Guards",

          }
        ]
      },

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\core\\src\\plan\\mod.rs",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "//! plan mode implementation",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Provides read-only planning phase with approval gates, budget enforcement,",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "//! and multiple execution strategies (single, orchestrated, competition).",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ## Integration with Official Plan Mode",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "//! This custom Plan module extends the official Plan Mode collaboration template",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "//! (&#96;codex-rs/core/templates/collaboration_mode/plan.md&#96;) with advanced features",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "//! while maintaining alignment with the official 2-phase conversational approach.",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Official Plan Mode Structure",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "//! The official Plan Mode (improved in commits #9877, #9874) uses a conversational",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "//! 2-phase approach:",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "//! 1. **PHASE 1 — Intent chat**: Understand what the user actually wants",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Goal + success criteria, audience, in/out of scope, constraints, current state",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Key preferences/tradeoffs",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Bias toward questions over guessing",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "//! 2. **PHASE 2 — Implementation chat**: Technical spec and implementation plan",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Approach, interfaces (APIs/schemas/I/O), data flow",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Edge cases/failure modes, testing + acceptance criteria",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Rollout/monitoring, migrations/compat constraints",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Key Principles from Official Improvements",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Ask a lot, but never ask trivia**: Questions must materially change the spec/plan,",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "//!   confirm/lock assumptions, or choose between meaningful tradeoffs",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Batch questions**: 4-10 questions per &#96;request_user_input&#96; call to keep momentum",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Two kinds of unknowns**:",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "//!   1. Discoverable facts: Explore first (≥2 targeted searches) before asking",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "//!   2. Preferences/tradeoffs: Ask early with 2-4 options + recommended default",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Finalization rule**: Only output final plan when remaining unknowns are low-impact",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "//!   and explicitly listed as assumptions",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Custom Plan Features",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "//! This module adds advanced capabilities beyond the official template:",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Budget management**: Token and time budgets with per-step and session caps",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Execution logging**: Detailed event-based logs of plan execution",
            "lineNumber": 43
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.2231367975473404
    },

          },

            "text": "impl Guards {",

          {

          {
            "text": "    pub(crate) fn release_spawned_thread(&amp;self, thread_id: ThreadId) {",

          },
          {
            "text": "        let removed = {",

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "        if removed {",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {

          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "    fn try_increment_spawned(&amp;self, max_threads: usize) -&gt; bool {",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "## 概要",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "upstream/main（OpenAI公式リポジトリ）の最新変更を取り込み、以下の作業を実施します：",

          },
          {

          },

          },

          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "**目的**: マージ前に独自機能を保護し、コンフリクトを最小化",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "**作業内容**:",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "1. 現在のブランチ状態を確認",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;git status&#96;で変更状況を確認",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "   - 未コミットの変更があればコミット",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "2. upstreamリモートの設定確認",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;git remote -v&#96;でupstreamが設定されているか確認",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "   - 未設定の場合は追加: &#96;git remote add upstream &lt;upstream-url&gt;&#96;",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "3. upstream/mainの最新取得",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;git fetch upstream main&#96;",

          },
          {
            "text": "   - 最新コミットを確認",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56
          },

          {

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "&lt;!-- 955c7e55-e604-4504-8f1e-1e871402392f 85f2d8b8-f3ee-4840-bcee-e8c7680c078b --&gt;",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "# TUI最新機能マージ計画",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "## 概要",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "upstream/mainからTUI関連の最新変更を取り込み、独自機能を保持しながらマージし、ビルドと起動テストまで実施します。",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "## ステップ",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "### Phase 1: 下準備と差分確認",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;git fetch upstream&#96; で最新mainを取得",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;git status&#96; / &#96;git diff upstream/main -- codex-rs/tui&#96; などで現状差分と独自変更を把握",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "### Phase 2: マージ (ours優先ベース)",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;git merge upstream/main -X ours&#96; で全体を ours 優先でマージ",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "- コンフリクトが発生したTUI関連ファイル（例: &#96;codex-rs/tui/src/**&#96;, &#96;codex-rs/tui/Cargo.toml&#96;, &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/main.rs&#96; のTUI起動ロジックなど）を個別に精査",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- 上流の新機能コードを取り込みつつ、独自機能や設定は維持（必要に応じて手動マージ）",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "### Phase 3: ビルドと依存関係更新",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;just tui-build&#96; または &#96;cargo build --release -p codex-tui&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- 依存関係更新が必要な場合は &#96;cargo update -p &lt;crate&gt;&#96; で対応",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "### Phase 4: 起動確認",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex tui&#96; でTUIを起動し、主要機能（画面表示、エージェント操作など）が動作するか手動確認",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "### Phase 5: 実装ログ作成",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;_docs/&#96; に &#96;yyyy-mm-dd_TUI最新マージ完了.md&#96; を作成し、マージ内容・ビルド結果・起動確認結果・残課題を記録",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "### To-dos",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "- [ ] Phase 1.3: GUI-CLI通信拡張 - RPCメソッド追加 (resource.getStatus, resource.acquire, resource.release, cli.codex.execute, cli.gemini.execute, cli.claude.execute)",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "- [ ] Phase 7.1: GeminiCLI MCP化拡張 - MCPサーバー起動とCodex統合改善",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "- [ ] Phase 7.2: DeepResearch統合 - GeminiCLI経由のDeepResearch実行とGUI表示",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "- [ ] Phase 8.1: /plan機能拡張 - Cursor風UI実装とPlanCreator.tsx作成",
            "lineNumber": 39

            "lineNumber": 154
          },
          {
            "text": "fn emit_skill_load_warnings(app_event_tx: &amp;AppEventSender, errors: &amp;[SkillErrorInfo]) {",
            "lineNumber": 155
          },
          {
            "text": "    if errors.is_empty() {",

            "text": "        return;",
            "lineNumber": 157
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 158
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 159
          },
          {
            "text": "    let error_count = errors.len();",

          },
          {
            "text": "    app_event_tx.send(AppEvent::InsertHistoryCell(Box::new(",
            "lineNumber": 161
          },
          {
            "text": "        crate::history_cell::new_warning_event(format!(",

          },
          {

          },

            "lineNumber": 164
          },
          {
            "text": "    )));",
            "lineNumber": 165
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 166
          },
          {
            "text": "    for error in errors {",

          },
          {
            "text": "        let path = error.path.display();",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 171
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 172
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 173
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 175
          },
          {

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 114

            "text": "    /// Real-time file monitoring (watch for file changes)",

            "lineNumber": 479
          },

            "lineNumber": 480

            "text": "            let results = self.scan_directory(dir_path).await?;",

          },

            "lineNumber": 489

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Signature-based scanning",
            "lineNumber": 492

          },

            "text": "        let mut results = Vec::new();",

          {
            "lineNumber": 500
          },
          {

          {

          {
            "text": "                .windows(signature.pattern.len())",

          },

            "lineNumber": 504
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "                results.push(MalwareDetectionResult {",

          {

          },

          {

          },
          {

          },

          },

          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "          if (mode === 'vr' || mode === 'ar') {",

          },
          {
            "text": "            if ('xr' in navigator) {",

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "                  deviceAvailable = await xr.isSessionSupported(sessionType);",

          },
          {
            "text": "                  if (!deviceAvailable) {",

          },
          {
            "text": "                    deviceWarning = &#96;${mode.toUpperCase()} device not available. Falling back to desktop mode.&#96;;",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "                  }",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "                } catch (err) {",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "                  deviceWarning = &#96;Failed to check ${mode.toUpperCase()} device availability: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error'}&#96;;",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "                  deviceAvailable = false;",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "                }",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "              } else {",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "                deviceWarning = 'WebXR not available in this browser. Falling back to desktop mode.';",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "                deviceAvailable = false;",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "              }",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "            } else {",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "              deviceWarning = 'WebXR not supported in this browser. Falling back to desktop mode.';",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "              deviceAvailable = false;",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "            }",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "          } else {",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "            deviceAvailable = true; // Desktop mode always available",

          },
          {
            "text": "          }",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "          ",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "          const apiUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || 'http://localhost:8787';",

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "export const Git4DWebXRFramework: React.FC =  {",

            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "  const [arSupported, setArSupported] = useState(false);",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },

          },

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "  // VirtualDesktop最適化",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "  const { preset, isVD, changePreset } = useVirtualDesktopOptimizer();",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "  // Initialize XR support check",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "  useEffect(() =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "    const checkXRSupport = async () =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "      try {",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "        const xr = (navigator as NavigatorXR).xr;",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "        if (!xr) {",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "          setXrSupported(false);",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "          setError('WebXR is not supported in this browser');",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "          return;",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "        const vrSupport = await xr.isSessionSupported('immersive-vr');",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "        const arSupport = await xr.isSessionSupported('immersive-ar');",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "        setXrSupported(true);",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "        setVrSupported(vrSupport);",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "        setArSupported(arSupport);",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "        if (!vrSupport &amp;&amp; !arSupport) {",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "          setError('Neither VR nor AR is supported on this device');",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "        setIsInitialized(true);",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "      } catch (err) {",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "        setXrSupported(false);",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "        setError(&#96;XR support check failed: ${err}&#96;);",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "        setIsInitialized(true);",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "      }",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "    };",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "    checkXRSupport();",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "  }, []);",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "  // XR event handlers",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "  useEffect(() =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (!xrManager) return;",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "  }",
            "lineNumber": 120

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "export default function Git4DPage() {",
            "lineNumber": 19,
            "isSignature": true
          },
          {
            "text": "() =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "const launchSession = async ",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "          ",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "          // VirtualDesktop検出結果を追加（クライアント側検出）",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "          if (isVD &amp;&amp; (mode === 'vr' || mode === 'ar')) {",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "            requestBody.virtualDesktop = true;",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "            console.log('VirtualDesktop detected - sending detection result to API');",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "          }",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "          ",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "          const response = await fetch(&#96;${apiUrl}/api/visualization/git4d&#96;, {",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "            method: 'POST',",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "            headers: {",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "              'Content-Type': 'application/json',",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "            },",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "            body: JSON.stringify(requestBody),",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "          });",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "          ",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "          if (!response.ok) {",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "            const errorData = await response.json().catch(() =&gt; ({ message: 'Unknown error' }));",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "            throw new Error(errorData.message || &#96;HTTP ${response.status}&#96;);",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "          }",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "          ",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "          const data = await response.json() as Git4DLaunchResponse;",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "          setSessionId(data.sessionId);",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "          ",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "          // 検出されたプラットフォーム情報を保存",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "          if (data.platform) {",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "            setDetectedPlatform(data.platform);",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "            if (data.device_name) {",
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "              console.log(&#96;Platform detected: ${data.platform} (${data.device_name})&#96;);",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "            } else {",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "text": "              console.log(&#96;Platform detected: ${data.platform}&#96;);",
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "            }",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "text": "          }",
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "          ",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "text": "          // VirtualDesktop検出時の通知",
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "text": "          if (isVD &amp;&amp; (mode === 'vr' || mode === 'ar')) {",
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "text": "            console.log(&#96;VirtualDesktop optimizations applied: ${preset.name} (${preset.targetFps} FPS)&#96;);",
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "          }",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "          ",
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "text": "          // Show warning if device was not available",
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "text": "          if (deviceWarning) {",
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "            console.warn(deviceWarning);",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "text": "          }",
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "text": "        } catch (err) {",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "text": "          setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to launch visualization');",
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "text": "        } finally {",
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "          setIsLoading(false);",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "      }",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "text": "    };",
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "text": "    launchSession();",
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "text": "  }, [mode, repositoryPath, sessionId]);",
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "text": "  ",
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "text": "  return (",
            "lineNumber": 131
          },
          {
            "text": "    &lt;Container maxWidth=\"xl\" sx={{ py: 4 }}&gt;",
            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 356,
            "isSignature": true
          }
        ]

          },

            "lineNumber": 391
          },
          {
            "text": "      await this.renderer.xr.setSession(this.xrSession)",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 393
          },
          {
            "text": "      const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera()",

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 399
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 401
          },
          {

          },

          },

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "(\"Failed to create HTTP client\")?;",
            "lineNumber": 296
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 297
          },
          {
            "text": "    let payload = serde_json::json!({",
            "lineNumber": 298

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 302
          },
          {
            "text": "    tracing::debug!(\"Launching Git4D visualization: mode={}, path={:?}\", mode, repository_path);",
            "lineNumber": 303
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 304
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Attempt to connect to GUI API",
            "lineNumber": 305
          },
          {
            "text": "    let response = match client",
            "lineNumber": 306
          },
          {
            "text": "        .post(&amp;url)",

          },
          {
            "text": "        .json(&amp;payload)",
            "lineNumber": 308
          },
          {
            "text": "        .send()",

          },
          {
            "text": "        .await",
            "lineNumber": 310
          },
          {
            "text": "    {",
            "lineNumber": 311
          },
          {
            "text": "        Ok(res) =&gt; res,",
            "lineNumber": 312
          },
          {
            "text": "        Err(e) =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 313
          },
          {
            "text": "            if e.is_timeout() || e.is_connect() {",
            "lineNumber": 314
          },
          {
            "text": "                anyhow::bail!(",
            "lineNumber": 315
          },
          {
            "text": "                    \"GUI server is not running or not accessible at {}. Please start the GUI server (codex-gui) and try again.\",",
            "lineNumber": 316
          },
          {
            "text": "                    url",
            "lineNumber": 317
          },
          {
            "text": "                );",
            "lineNumber": 318
          },
          {
            "text": "            }",
            "lineNumber": 319
          },
          {
            "text": "            return Err(e).context(\"Failed to send request to GUI API\");",
            "lineNumber": 320
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 321
          },
          {
            "text": "    };",
            "lineNumber": 322
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 323
          },
          {
            "text": "    if !response.status().is_success() {",
            "lineNumber": 324
          },
          {
            "text": "        let status = response.status();",
            "lineNumber": 325
          },
          {
            "text": "        let error_text = response.text().await.unwrap_or_else(|_| \"Unknown error\".to_string());",
            "lineNumber": 326
          },
          {
            "text": "        ",
            "lineNumber": 327
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Provide user-friendly error messages",
            "lineNumber": 328
          },
          {
            "text": "        let error_msg = match status.as_u16() {",
            "lineNumber": 329
          },
          {
            "text": "            404 =&gt; format!(\"Visualization endpoint not found. The GUI server may need to be updated.\"),",
            "lineNumber": 330
          },
          {
            "text": "            422 =&gt; format!(\"Invalid request parameters: {}\", error_text),",
            "lineNumber": 331
          },
          {
            "text": "            500 =&gt; format!(\"Server error while launching visualization: {}\", error_text),",
            "lineNumber": 332
          },
          {
            "text": "            _ =&gt; format!(\"GUI API returned error status {}: {}\", status, error_text),",
            "lineNumber": 333
          },
          {
            "text": "        };",
            "lineNumber": 334
          },
          {
            "text": "        ",
            "lineNumber": 335
          },
          {
            "text": "        anyhow::bail!(\"{}\", error_msg);",
            "lineNumber": 336
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 337
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 338
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Check response for VR/AR device availability warnings",
            "lineNumber": 339
          },
          {
            "text": "    if mode == \"vr\" || mode == \"ar\" {",
            "lineNumber": 340
          },
          {
            "text": "        let response_text = response.text().await.unwrap_or_default();",
            "lineNumber": 341
          },
          {
            "text": "        if response_text.contains(\"device not available\") || response_text.contains(\"VR not available\") {",
            "lineNumber": 342
          },
          {
            "text": "            tracing::warn!(",
            "lineNumber": 343
          },
          {

          },

          },

          },

          },

            "text": "    ",

          },
          {
            "text": "    tracing::info!",

## 完了した作業のまとめ

Phase 5拡張版の実行計画を実装しました。

### 完了したフェーズ

1. **Phase 5.1**: 型安全性と警告0達成（コード修正のみ）
2. **Phase 5.2**: React 19.2.1+への安全なアップグレード
3. **Phase 5.3**: VR/AR機能強化（Apple Glass、VIVE、SteamVR対応）
4. **Phase 5.4**: その他機能強化
   - 5.4.1: macOSライクサンドボックス + cowork統合
   - 5.4.2: DeepResearchレポート強化
   - 5.4.3: Windows 11 25H2 MCP対応
   - 5.4.4: ランサムウェア対策の追加
   - 5.4.5: 複数AIツール並列実行GUI実装
5. **Phase 5.5**: コードレビューとAPI再実装
   - Git差分分析を実施
   - 非推奨APIを最新APIに置き換え（`ConversationManager` → `ThreadManager`など）
   - TypeScriptの`any`型を具体的な型定義に置き換え
   - Rustの`unwrap()`を適切なエラーハンドリングに置き換え
6. **Phase 5.6**: 実装ログ作成
   - `_docs/2026-01-26_Phase5拡張版コードレビューとAPI再実装main.md`に保存

### 次のステップ

          {
            "text": "# 公式機能統合とupstream/mainマージ計画",

            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "## 概要",

          },
          {
            "text": "upstream/main（OpenAI公式リポジトリ）の最新変更を取り込み、以下の作業を実施します：",

          {

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "**作業内容**:",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "1. 現在のブランチ状態を確認",

          },

            "lineNumber": 44
          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },

          {
            "text": "## 💡 教訓",
            "lineNumber": 680
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 681
          },
          {
            "text": "### うまくいったこと",
            "lineNumber": 682
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 683
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **モジュール分離**: blueprint, telemetry, webhooksを完全分離 → テスト・保守が容易",
            "lineNumber": 684
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Type-safe State Machine**: Enum with dataでコンパイル時検証",
            "lineNumber": 685
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Dual Format Persistence**: MD (human) + JSON (machine) → 両方の利点",
            "lineNumber": 686
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Privacy by Design**: 最初からhashing組み込み → 後付け不要",
            "lineNumber": 687
          },
          {
            "text": "5. **Embedded Unit Tests**: 各moduleに tests → coverage高い",
            "lineNumber": 688
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 689
          },
          {
            "text": "### 改善点",
            "lineNumber": 690
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 691
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Stub実装多め**: RPC handlersが現時点でstub → Phase 10で実装必要",
            "lineNumber": 692
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Integration Tests後回し**: Unit first → integration後 (正しいが時間かかる)",
            "lineNumber": 693
          }
        ]

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "        if ($rustChanges.Count -eq 0 -and -not $Release) {",

          },

          },

          {
            "text": "        } else {",

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "    def incremental_build(self, target: str = \"debug\") -&gt; bool:",

          },
          {
            "text": "        \"\"\"差分ビルドを実行\"\"\"",

          },

            "text": "        changes = self.detect_changes()",

          },

            "lineNumber": 195
          },
          {
            "text": "        total_changes = len(changes['modified']) + len(changes['new']) + len(changes['deleted'])",

          },
          {
            "text": "        print(f\"[STATS] 検出された変更: {total_changes} files\")",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 198
          },
          {
            "text": "        if total_changes &gt; 0:",

          },
          {
            "text": "            print(f\"  [DELETED] 削除: {len(changes['deleted'])} files\")",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 203
          },
          {
            "text": "        # フルビルド判定",
            "lineNumber": 204
          },
          {
            "text": "        if self.should_full_build(changes) or total_changes == 0:",

          },
          {
            "text": "            if total_changes == 0:",

          },
          {
            "text": "                print(\"[TARGET] 前回ビルドから変更なし - スキップします\")",

          },

            "text": "                return self.run_build(target)",

          },
