    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\architecture\\build-optimization.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 80
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 🚀 Rust ビルド高速化ガイド",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📊 高速化設定概要",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "### 適用済み最適化",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "- **並列ビルド**: 16並列ジョブ（CPU cores全活用）",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "- **LLDリンカー**: 標準MSVCより2-3倍高速",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "- **インクリメンタルコンパイル**: 差分ビルド高速化",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "- **CPU最適化**: &#96;target-cpu=native&#96; で現在のCPU専用最適化",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 ビルドコマンド比較",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. 標準ビルド（遅い）",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "cd codex-rs",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "cargo build --release -p codex-cli",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "# 推定時間: 8-12分",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. 高速ビルド（推奨）",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": ".\\fast-build.ps1 -Release",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "# 推定時間: 3-5分（初回）、30秒-1分（再ビルド）",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. 最速デバッグビルド",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": ".\\fast-build.ps1",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "# 推定時間: 1-2分（初回）、10-30秒（再ビルド）",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4. クリーンビルド",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": ".\\fast-build.ps1 -Release -Clean",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "# 推定時間: 4-6分",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "## ⚙️ 設定ファイル",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "### &#96;.cargo/config.toml&#96;（作成済み）",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;toml",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "[build]",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "jobs = 16           # 並列ジョブ数（CPU cores数に合わせる）",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "incremental = true  # インクリメンタルビルド",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "[target.x86_64-pc-windows-msvc]",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "rustflags = [",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"-C\", \"link-arg=-fuse-ld=lld\",  # LLDリンカー使用",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"-C\", \"target-cpu=native\",      # CPU最適化",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "]",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📈 パフォーマンス比較",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "### 初回ビルド",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "| 方法 | 時間 | 高速化率 |",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "|------|------|---------|",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "| 標準 | 10分 | 1x |",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "| 高速（16並列） | 4分 | **2.5x** |",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "| 高速（32並列） | 3分 | **3.3x** |",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "### 再ビルド（1ファイル変更）",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "| 方法 | 時間 | 高速化率 |",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "|------|------|---------|",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "| 標準 | 2分 | 1x |",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "| 高速+Incremental | 20秒 | **6x** |",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🔧 環境別チューニング",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "### CPU Cores数の確認",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "(Get-WmiObject Win32_Processor).NumberOfLogicalProcessors",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "### 推奨並列ジョブ数",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "- **8 cores**: &#96;-j 8&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "- **12 cores**: &#96;-j 12&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "- **16 cores**: &#96;-j 16&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "- **24+ cores**: &#96;-j 24&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 79
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.5463742017745972
    },
    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\experimental-scripts\\fast-build.ps1",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 57
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 高速ビルドスクリプト",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "# 並列化 + LLDリンカー + インクリメンタルビルド",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "param(",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "    [switch]$Clean,",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "    [switch]$Release,",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "    [int]$Jobs = 16  # CPU cores数に応じて調整",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": ")",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "$ErrorActionPreference = \"Continue\"",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "Write-Host \"========================================\" -ForegroundColor Cyan",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "Write-Host \" Rust Fast Build\" -ForegroundColor Cyan",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "Write-Host \"========================================\" -ForegroundColor Cyan",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "Write-Host \"\"",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "# System info",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "$cpuCores = (Get-WmiObject Win32_Processor).NumberOfLogicalProcessors",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "Write-Host \"CPU Cores: $cpuCores\" -ForegroundColor White",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "Write-Host \"Parallel Jobs: $Jobs\" -ForegroundColor White",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "Write-Host \"\"",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "Set-Location \"codex-rs\"",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "if ($Clean) {",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "    Write-Host \"Cleaning build cache...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "    cargo clean",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "    Write-Host \"Clean complete!\" -ForegroundColor Green",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "    Write-Host \"\"",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "Write-Host \"Starting fast build...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "Write-Host \"  Package: codex-cli\" -ForegroundColor Gray",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "Write-Host \"  Profile: $(if ($Release) { 'release' } else { 'dev' })\" -ForegroundColor Gray",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "Write-Host \"  Jobs: $Jobs\" -ForegroundColor Gray",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "Write-Host \"\"",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "$buildStart = Get-Date",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "if ($Release) {",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "    # リリースビルド（高速版プロファイル使用可能）",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "    cargo build --release -p codex-cli -j $Jobs",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "} else {",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "    # デバッグビルド（インクリメンタル有効）",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "    cargo build -p codex-cli -j $Jobs",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "$buildEnd = Get-Date",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "$duration = ($buildEnd - $buildStart).TotalSeconds",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "Set-Location \"..\"",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "Write-Host \"\"",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "Write-Host \"========================================\" -ForegroundColor Cyan",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "    $binaryPath = if ($Release) { \"codex-rs\\target\\release\\codex.exe\" } else { \"codex-rs\\target\\debug\\codex.exe\" }",
            "lineNumber": 57
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.543070375919342
    },
    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\build-performance-guide.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 90
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# ⚡ Codex Rust ビルド高速化ガイド",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**最終更新**: 2025-10-15  ",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "**対象バージョン**: codex v0.48.0  ",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**推定効果**: フルビルド 15〜25分 → **3〜7分**、差分ビルド **30秒〜2分**",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🚀 即効性のある高速化（今すぐ実行可能）",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. sccache導入（最優先）",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "**効果**: 2回目以降のビルドが **70〜90%高速化**",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "# 自動インストール&amp;セットアップ",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "cd codex-rs",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": ".\\install-sccache.ps1",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "# 手動インストール",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "cargo install sccache",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "$env:RUSTC_WRAPPER = \"sccache\"",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "# PowerShellプロファイルに追加（永続化）",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "Add-Content $PROFILE \"&#96;n&#96;$env:RUSTC_WRAPPER = 'sccache'\"",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "**確認**:",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "sccache --show-stats",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "# 出力例:",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "# Compile requests: 150",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "# Cache hits: 120 (80%)",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "# Cache misses: 30 (20%)",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. 並列ビルドジョブ数最適化",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "**効果**: CPU使用率最適化、ビルド時間 **10〜20%短縮**",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "すでに &#96;.cargo/config.toml&#96; に設定済み：",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;toml",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "[build]",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "jobs = 8                    # RTX3080システム（論理16コア）で最適値",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "**カスタマイズ**:",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "# CPU論理コア数確認",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "Get-WmiObject Win32_Processor | Select-Object NumberOfLogicalProcessors",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "# 推奨値: 論理コア数 - (2〜4)",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "# 例: 16コア → jobs = 8〜12",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. 増分コンパイル有効化",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "**効果**: 差分ビルド **50〜70%高速化**",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "すでに &#96;.cargo/config.toml&#96; に設定済み：",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;toml",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "[build]",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "incremental = true          # 開発時の差分ビルド高速化",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "**注意**: リリースビルド（&#96;lto = \"fat\"&#96;）とは併用不可（自動で無効化される）",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 開発フロー別の推奨設定",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "### パターンA: 日常開発（最速）",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "# 開発用プロファイル（LTO無効）",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "cargo build -p codex-cli",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "# ビルド時間: 初回 3〜7分、差分 30秒〜2分",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "**Cargo.toml設定**（既に適用済み）:",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;toml",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "[profile.dev]",
            "lineNumber": 90
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.5392418503761292
    },

          },
          {
            "text": "## Integration Points",
            "lineNumber": 335
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 336
          },
          {
            "text": "### Development Workflow",
            "lineNumber": 337
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 338
          },
          {
            "text": "# Fast development iteration",
            "lineNumber": 339
          },
          {
            "text": "codex $build-manager \"Incremental dev build\"",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\CHANGELOG.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 49
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Changelog",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/),",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "## [2.9.0] - 2026-01-04 - \"Fast Build &amp; Hot Reload System\"",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "### 🚀 Major Features",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "**This release introduces a complete build and deployment pipeline overhaul with hot reload capabilities and integrated release packaging.**",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "### ✅ Added",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Fast Incremental Build System (&#96;scripts/fast_build.py&#96;)**",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "  - MD5 hash-based change detection for intelligent rebuilds",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Cargo incremental compilation optimization",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Parallel build processing with CPU core utilization",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "  - tqdm-powered progress visualization",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Build cache persistence (&#96;.build_cache.pkl&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Hot Reload Installation System (&#96;scripts/build_and_install.py&#96;)**",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Cross-platform process detection and termination (psutil)",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Atomic binary replacement with safety checks",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Platform-specific installation (Windows/macOS/Linux)",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Installation verification with version checking",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "  - PowerShell integration for Windows deployment",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Integrated Release Packaging**",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "  - GitHub Actions workflow for cross-platform tgz packages",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "  - All-platform binaries in single downloadable archive",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Automated install script generation (&#96;install.sh&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Comprehensive release documentation (&#96;INSTALL.md&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Release notes with installation instructions",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Development Tools Enhancement**",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;just fast-build&#96; - Quick incremental builds",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;just build-install&#96; - Full pipeline execution",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;just install-kill&#96; - Direct binary replacement",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Process-safe deployment with zero-downtime updates",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "### 🎯 Performance Improvements",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Build Speed**: Up to 70% faster incremental builds with change detection",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Deployment Time**: Instant hot reload with process management",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Release Size**: Optimized binaries with integrated packaging",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Developer Experience**: One-command build and deploy workflow",
            "lineNumber": 48
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.5235253572463989
    },

            "text": "def build_codex():",
            "lineNumber": 77,
            "isSignature": true
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"\"\"高速差分ビルド実行\"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "    print(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*50)",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "    print(\"🦀 Rust高速差分ビルド\")",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "    print(\"=\"*50)",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "    codex_rs = Path(\"codex-rs\")",

          },
          {
            "text": "    if not codex_rs.exists():",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "        return False",

          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "    print(f\"  ディレクトリ: {codex_rs.absolute()}\")",

          },
          {
            "text": "    print(\"  パッケージ: codex-cli\")",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "    print(\"  プロファイル: release\")",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "    print(\"  インクリメンタル: 有効\")",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "    print()",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "    start_time = time.time()",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "    # 環境変数設定",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "    env = os.environ.copy()",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "    env[\"CARGO_INCREMENTAL\"] = \"1\"",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "    # ビルド実行",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "    cmd = \"cargo build --release -p codex-cli\"",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "    result = run_cmd(cmd, cwd=codex_rs, check=False)",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "    build_time = time.time() - start_time",

          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "    if result.returncode == 0:",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "text": "        print(f\"\\n  ✅ ビルド完了 ({build_time:.2f}秒)\")",
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "        return True",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "text": "    else:",

          },
          {
            "text": "        print(f\"\\n  ❌ ビルド失敗 ({build_time:.2f}秒)\")",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "text": "        return False",
            "lineNumber": 111,

            "lineNumber": 112

            "text": "fn generate_openxr_bindings() {",

          },
          {
            "text": "    use std::path::PathBuf;",

          {

          },
          {
            "text": "    ",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 98

          {

          {
            "text": "            PathBuf::from(\"/usr/include/openxr/openxr.h\")",

          },
          {
            "text": "            PathBuf::from(\"C:/OpenXR-SDK/include/openxr/openxr.h\")",

          },
          {
            "text": "            PathBuf::from(\"/usr/local/include/openxr/openxr.h\")",

            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "    };",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "text": "    if !header_path.exists() {",
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "text": "        println!(\"cargo:warning=OpenXR header not found at {:?}\", header_path);",
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "        println!(\"cargo:warning=Set OPENXR_SDK_PATH environment variable or install OpenXR SDK\");",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "        return;",
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "text": "    let out_path = PathBuf::from(env::var(\"OUT_DIR\").unwrap());",

          },

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\scripts\\setup-windows.ps1",

          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "if (-not (Ensure-Command 'cargo')) {",
            "lineNumber": 169
          },
          {
            "text": "  # Some shells need a re-login; attempt to source cargo.env if present",
            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {
            "text": "  $cargoEnv = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE \".cargo\\env\"",
            "lineNumber": 171
          },
          {
            "text": "  if (Test-Path $cargoEnv) { . $cargoEnv }",
            "lineNumber": 172
          },
          {
            "text": "  Add-CargoBinToPath",
            "lineNumber": 173
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "text": "if (-not (Ensure-Command 'cargo')) {",
            "lineNumber": 175
          },
          {
            "text": "  throw \"cargo not found in PATH after rustup install. Please open a new terminal and re-run the script.\"",
            "lineNumber": 176
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 177
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 178
          },
          {
            "text": "Write-Host \"==&gt; Configuring Rust toolchain per rust-toolchain.toml\" -ForegroundColor Cyan",
            "lineNumber": 179
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {
            "text": "# Pin to the workspace toolchain and install components",
            "lineNumber": 181
          },
          {
            "text": "$toolchain = '1.92.0'",
            "lineNumber": 182
          },
          {
            "text": "&amp; rustup toolchain install $toolchain --profile minimal | Out-Host",
            "lineNumber": 183
          },
          {
            "text": "&amp; rustup default $toolchain | Out-Host",
            "lineNumber": 184
          },
          {
            "text": "&amp; rustup component add clippy rustfmt rust-src --toolchain $toolchain | Out-Host",
            "lineNumber": 185
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 186
          },
          {
            "text": "# 6.5) LLVM/Clang (some crates/bindgen require clang/libclang)",
            "lineNumber": 187
          },
          {
            "text": "function Add-LLVMToPath() {",
            "lineNumber": 188
          },
          {
            "text": "  $llvmBin = 'C:\\\\Program Files\\\\LLVM\\\\bin'",
            "lineNumber": 189
          },
          {
            "text": "  if (Test-Path $llvmBin) {",
            "lineNumber": 190
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (-not ($env:Path.Split(';') -contains $llvmBin)) {",
            "lineNumber": 191
          },
          {
            "text": "      $env:Path = \"$env:Path;$llvmBin\"",
            "lineNumber": 192
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 193
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (-not $env:LIBCLANG_PATH) {",
            "lineNumber": 194
          },
          {
            "text": "      $env:LIBCLANG_PATH = $llvmBin",
            "lineNumber": 195
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 196
          },
          {
            "text": "    Ensure-UserPathContains $llvmBin",
            "lineNumber": 197
          },
          {
            "text": "    Ensure-UserEnvVar -Name 'LIBCLANG_PATH' -Value $llvmBin",
            "lineNumber": 198
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 199
          },
          {
            "text": "    $clang = Join-Path $llvmBin 'clang.exe'",
            "lineNumber": 200
          },
          {
            "text": "    $clangxx = Join-Path $llvmBin 'clang++.exe'",
            "lineNumber": 201
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (Test-Path $clang) {",
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {
            "text": "      $env:CC = $clang",
            "lineNumber": 203
          },
          {
            "text": "      Ensure-UserEnvVar -Name 'CC' -Value $clang",
            "lineNumber": 204
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 205
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (Test-Path $clangxx) {",
            "lineNumber": 206
          },
          {
            "text": "      $env:CXX = $clangxx",
            "lineNumber": 207
          },
          {
            "text": "      Ensure-UserEnvVar -Name 'CXX' -Value $clangxx",
            "lineNumber": 208
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 209
          },
          {
            "text": "  }",
            "lineNumber": 210
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 211
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 212
          },
          {
            "text": "Write-Host \"-- Installing LLVM/Clang\" -ForegroundColor DarkCyan",
            "lineNumber": 213
          },
          {
            "text": "winget install @WingetArgs --id LLVM.LLVM | Out-Host",
            "lineNumber": 214
          },
          {
            "text": "Add-LLVMToPath",
            "lineNumber": 215
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 216
          },

            "text": "    $clangxx = Join-Path $llvmBin 'clang++.exe'",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\scripts\\setup-windows.ps1",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 59
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "&lt;#",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "  Setup script for building codex-rs on Windows.",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "  What it does:",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Installs Rust toolchain (via winget rustup) and required components",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Installs Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools (MSVC + Windows SDK)",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Installs helpful CLIs used by the repo: git, ripgrep (rg), just, cmake",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Installs cargo-insta (for snapshot tests) via cargo",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Ensures PATH contains Cargo bin for the current session",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Builds the workspace (cargo build)",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "  Usage:",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "    - Right-click PowerShell and \"Run as Administrator\" (VS Build Tools require elevation)",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "    - From the repo root (codex-rs), run:",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "        powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/setup-windows.ps1",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "  Notes:",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "    - Requires winget (Windows Package Manager). Most modern Windows 10/11 have it preinstalled.",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "    - The script is re-runnable; winget/cargo will skip/reinstall as appropriate.",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "#&gt;",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "param(",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "  [switch] $SkipBuild",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": ")",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "function Ensure-Command($Name) {",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "  $exists = Get-Command $Name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "  return $null -ne $exists",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "function Add-CargoBinToPath() {",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "  $cargoBin = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE \".cargo\\bin\"",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "  if (Test-Path $cargoBin) {",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (-not ($env:Path.Split(';') -contains $cargoBin)) {",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "      $env:Path = \"$env:Path;$cargoBin\"",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "  }",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "function Ensure-UserPathContains([string] $Segment) {",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "  try {",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "    $userPath = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path', 'User')",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "    if ($null -eq $userPath) { $userPath = '' }",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "    $parts = $userPath.Split(';') | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' }",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (-not ($parts -contains $Segment)) {",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "      $newPath = if ($userPath) { \"$userPath;$Segment\" } else { $Segment }",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "      [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('Path', $newPath, 'User')",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "  } catch {}",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "function Ensure-UserEnvVar([string] $Name, [string] $Value) {",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "  try { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($Name, $Value, 'User') } catch {}",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "function Ensure-VSComponents([string[]]$Components) {",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "  $vsInstaller = \"${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\\Microsoft Visual Studio\\Installer\\vs_installer.exe\"",
            "lineNumber": 59
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.42899540066719055
    },

        "detailedLines": [

          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 150
          },
          {
            "text": "# 3) Git (often present, but ensure installed)",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 154
          },
          {
            "text": "# 4) ripgrep (rg)",

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 162
          },
          {
            "text": "# 6) cmake (commonly needed by native crates)",

          },

            "lineNumber": 168
          },
          {
            "text": "if (-not (Ensure-Command 'cargo')) {",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 170
          }
        ]

          },
          {

          },

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\.github\\workflows\\rust-ci.yml",

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "components: rustfmt",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "text": "      - name: Cache Cargo incremental artifacts",
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "text": "        uses: actions/cache@v4",
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "        with:",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "          path: |",
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "text": "            ~/.cargo/registry",
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "text": "            ~/.cargo/git",
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "            target/",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "text": "            codex-rs/target/",
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "text": "          key: windows-fast-build-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock', '**/Cargo.toml') }}",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "text": "          restore-keys: |",
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "text": "            windows-fast-build-",
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "          save-always: true",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "      - name: Install sccache for faster compilation",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "text": "        uses: taiki-e/install-action@44c6d64aa62cd779e873306675c7a58e86d6d532",
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "text": "        with:",
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "text": "          tool: sccache",
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "text": "      - name: Configure incremental build (Avast Safe)",
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "text": "        run: |",
            "lineNumber": 131
          },
          {
            "text": "          echo \"CARGO_INCREMENTAL=1\" &gt;&gt; $env:GITHUB_ENV",
            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "text": "          echo \"RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache\" &gt;&gt; $env:GITHUB_ENV",
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "text": "          echo \"SCCACHE_CACHE_SIZE=5G\" &gt;&gt; $env:GITHUB_ENV",
            "lineNumber": 134
          },
          {
            "text": "          echo \"CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=8\" &gt;&gt; $env:GITHUB_ENV",
            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "text": "          echo \"RUST_BACKTRACE=1\" &gt;&gt; $env:GITHUB_ENV",
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "text": "          echo \"RUSTFLAGS=-C target-cpu=native -C opt-level=2 -C link-args=/DEBUG:NONE\" &gt;&gt; $env:GITHUB_ENV",
            "lineNumber": 137
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 138
          },
          {
            "text": "      - name: Setup Windows Defender exclusions (Avast compatibility)",
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "text": "        run: |",
            "lineNumber": 140
          },
          {
            "text": "          # Add common development paths to Windows Defender exclusions",
            "lineNumber": 141
          },
          {
            "text": "          # This helps prevent conflicts with Avast and other antivirus software",
            "lineNumber": 142
          },
          {
            "text": "          $exclusions = @(",
            "lineNumber": 143
          },
          {
            "text": "            \"$env:USERPROFILE\\.cargo\",",
            "lineNumber": 144
          },
          {
            "text": "            \"$env:USERPROFILE\\.rustup\",",
            "lineNumber": 145
          },
          {
            "text": "            \"$(pwd)\",",
            "lineNumber": 146
          },
          {
            "text": "            \"$(pwd)\\codex-rs\",",
            "lineNumber": 147
          },
          {
            "text": "            \"$(pwd)\\codex-rs\\target\",",
            "lineNumber": 148
          },
          {
            "text": "            \"C:\\Program Files\\Git\",",
            "lineNumber": 149
          },
          {
            "text": "            \"C:\\hostedtoolcache\\windows\\Python\"",
            "lineNumber": 150
          },
          {
            "text": "          )",
            "lineNumber": 151
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 152
          },
          {
            "text": "          foreach ($path in $exclusions) {",
            "lineNumber": 153
          },
          {
            "text": "            try {",
            "lineNumber": 154
          },
          {
            "text": "              Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath $path -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue",
            "lineNumber": 155
          },
          {
            "text": "              Write-Host \"Added exclusion: $path\"",
            "lineNumber": 156
          },
          {
            "text": "            } catch {",
            "lineNumber": 157
          },
          {
            "text": "              Write-Host \"Could not add exclusion: $path\"",
            "lineNumber": 158
          },
          {
            "text": "            }",
            "lineNumber": 159
          },
          {
            "text": "          }",
            "lineNumber": 160
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 161
          },
          {
            "text": "      - name: Setup Node.js",
            "lineNumber": 162
          },
          {
            "text": "        uses: actions/setup-node@v4",
            "lineNumber": 163
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.3876323699951172

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\_tmp\\untracked-backup\\.codex-worktrees\\upstream-sync\\codex-rs\\scripts\\setup-windows.ps1",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 59
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "&lt;#",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "  Setup script for building codex-rs on Windows.",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "  What it does:",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Installs Rust toolchain (via winget rustup) and required components",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Installs Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools (MSVC + Windows SDK)",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Installs helpful CLIs used by the repo: git, ripgrep (rg), just, cmake",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Installs cargo-insta (for snapshot tests) via cargo",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Ensures PATH contains Cargo bin for the current session",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Builds the workspace (cargo build)",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "  Usage:",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "    - Right-click PowerShell and \"Run as Administrator\" (VS Build Tools require elevation)",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "    - From the repo root (codex-rs), run:",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "        powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/setup-windows.ps1",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "  Notes:",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "    - Requires winget (Windows Package Manager). Most modern Windows 10/11 have it preinstalled.",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "    - The script is re-runnable; winget/cargo will skip/reinstall as appropriate.",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "#&gt;",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "param(",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "  [switch] $SkipBuild",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": ")",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "function Ensure-Command($Name) {",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "  $exists = Get-Command $Name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "  return $null -ne $exists",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "function Add-CargoBinToPath() {",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "  $cargoBin = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE \".cargo\\bin\"",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "  if (Test-Path $cargoBin) {",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (-not ($env:Path.Split(';') -contains $cargoBin)) {",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "      $env:Path = \"$env:Path;$cargoBin\"",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "  }",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "function Ensure-UserPathContains([string] $Segment) {",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "  try {",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "    $userPath = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path', 'User')",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "    if ($null -eq $userPath) { $userPath = '' }",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "    $parts = $userPath.Split(';') | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' }",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (-not ($parts -contains $Segment)) {",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "      $newPath = if ($userPath) { \"$userPath;$Segment\" } else { $Segment }",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "      [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('Path', $newPath, 'User')",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "  } catch {}",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "function Ensure-UserEnvVar([string] $Name, [string] $Value) {",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "  try { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($Name, $Value, 'User') } catch {}",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "function Ensure-VSComponents([string[]]$Components) {",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "  $vsInstaller = \"${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\\Microsoft Visual Studio\\Installer\\vs_installer.exe\"",
            "lineNumber": 59
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.3847399950027466
    },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "bazel_dep(name = \"openssl\", version = \"3.5.4.bcr.0\")",

          },

          },

          },

          },
          {

          },

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "pub async fn run_main(",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "text": "    mut cli: Cli,",
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "text": "    codex_linux_sandbox_exe: Option&lt;PathBuf&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": ") -&gt; std::io::Result&lt;AppExitInfo&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "    let (sandbox_mode, approval_policy) = if cli.full_auto {",

          },
          {
            "text": "        (",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "text": "        )",
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "text": "    } else if cli.dangerously_bypass_approvals_and_sandbox {",

          {

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "text": "        )",
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "text": "    } else {",

          },
          {
            "text": "        (",
            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "text": "            cli.sandbox_mode.map(Into::&lt;SandboxMode&gt;::into),",
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "text": "            cli.approval_policy.map(Into::into),",
            "lineNumber": 137
          },
          {
            "text": "        )",
            "lineNumber": 138
          },
          {
            "text": "    };",
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 140
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Map the legacy --search flag to the canonical web_search mode.",
            "lineNumber": 141
          },
          {
            "text": "    if cli.web_search {",
            "lineNumber": 142
          },
          {
            "text": "        cli.config_overrides",
            "lineNumber": 143
          },
          {
            "text": "            .raw_overrides",
            "lineNumber": 144
          },
          {
            "text": "            .push(\"web_search=\\\"live\\\"\".to_string());",

          },

            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 146
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 147
          },
          {
            "text": "    // When using &#96;--oss&#96;, let the bootstrapper pick the model (defaulting to",

            "lineNumber": 149
          },
          {
            "text": "    let raw_overrides = cli.config_overrides.raw_overrides.clone();",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 151
          },
          {
            "text": "    let overrides_cli = codex_common::CliConfigOverrides { raw_overrides };",
            "lineNumber": 152
          },
          {

          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 157
          },
          {
            "text": "            eprintln!(\"Error parsing -c overrides: {e}\");",
            "lineNumber": 158
          },
          {
            "text": "            std::process::exit(1);",
            "lineNumber": 159
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 160
          },
          {
            "text": "    };",
            "lineNumber": 161
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 162
          },
          {
            "text": "    // we load config.toml here to determine project state.",

          },
          {
            "text": "    #[allow(clippy::print_stderr)]",
            "lineNumber": 164
          },
          {
            "text": "    let codex_home = match find_codex_home() {",
            "lineNumber": 165
          },
          {
            "text": "        Ok(codex_home) =&gt; codex_home.to_path_buf(),",
            "lineNumber": 166
          },
          {

          },
          {

          {

          },

            "lineNumber": 174
          },

          {
            "text": "    mcp_url: Option&lt;String&gt;,",

          },
          {

          {

          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "    let actual_plan = if lightweight_fallback &amp;&amp; budget &lt; 30_000 {",

          },
          {

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "pub async fn run_main(",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "text": "    mut cli: Cli,",
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "text": "    codex_linux_sandbox_exe: Option&lt;PathBuf&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": ") -&gt; std::io::Result&lt;AppExitInfo&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "    let (sandbox_mode, approval_policy) = if cli.full_auto {",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "        (",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "text": "            Some(SandboxMode::WorkspaceWrite),",
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "text": "            Some(AskForApproval::OnRequest),",
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "text": "        )",
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "text": "    } else if cli.dangerously_bypass_approvals_and_sandbox {",
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "text": "        (",
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "text": "            Some(SandboxMode::DangerFullAccess),",
            "lineNumber": 131
          },
          {
            "text": "            Some(AskForApproval::Never),",
            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "text": "        )",
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "text": "    } else {",
            "lineNumber": 134
          },
          {
            "text": "        (",
            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "text": "            cli.sandbox_mode.map(Into::&lt;SandboxMode&gt;::into),",
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "text": "            cli.approval_policy.map(Into::into),",
            "lineNumber": 137
          },
          {
            "text": "        )",
            "lineNumber": 138
          },
          {
            "text": "    };",
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 140
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Map the legacy --search flag to the canonical web_search mode.",
            "lineNumber": 141
          },
          {
            "text": "    if cli.web_search {",
            "lineNumber": 142
          },
          {
            "text": "        cli.config_overrides",
            "lineNumber": 143
          },
          {
            "text": "            .raw_overrides",
            "lineNumber": 144
          },
          {
            "text": "            .push(\"web_search=\\\"live\\\"\".to_string());",
            "lineNumber": 145
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 146
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 147
          },
          {
            "text": "    // When using &#96;--oss&#96;, let the bootstrapper pick the model (defaulting to",

          },
          {
            "text": "    // gpt-oss:20b) and ensure it is present locally. Also, force the built‑in",
            "lineNumber": 149
          },
          {
            "text": "    let raw_overrides = cli.config_overrides.raw_overrides.clone();",
            "lineNumber": 150
          },
          {
            "text": "    // &#96;oss&#96; model provider.",
            "lineNumber": 151
          },
          {
            "text": "    let overrides_cli = codex_common::CliConfigOverrides { raw_overrides };",
            "lineNumber": 152
          },
          {
            "text": "    let cli_kv_overrides = match overrides_cli.parse_overrides() {",
            "lineNumber": 153
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Parse &#96;-c&#96; overrides from the CLI.",
            "lineNumber": 154
          },
          {
            "text": "        Ok(v) =&gt; v,",

          },
          {
            "text": "        #[allow(clippy::print_stderr)]",
            "lineNumber": 156
          },
          {
            "text": "        Err(e) =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 157
          },
          {
            "text": "            eprintln!(\"Error parsing -c overrides: {e}\");",
            "lineNumber": 158
          },
          {
            "text": "            std::process::exit(1);",
            "lineNumber": 159
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 160
          },
          {
            "text": "    };",
            "lineNumber": 161
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 162
          },
          {
            "text": "    // we load config.toml here to determine project state.",
            "lineNumber": 163
          },
          {
            "text": "    #[allow(clippy::print_stderr)]",
            "lineNumber": 164
          },
          {
            "text": "    let codex_home = match find_codex_home() {",
            "lineNumber": 165
          },
          {
            "text": "        Ok(codex_home) =&gt; codex_home.to_path_buf(),",
            "lineNumber": 166
          },
          {
            "text": "        Err(err) =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 167
          },
          {
            "text": "            eprintln!(\"Error finding codex home: {err}\");",
            "lineNumber": 168
          },
          {
            "text": "            std::process::exit(1);",
            "lineNumber": 169
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {
            "text": "    };",
            "lineNumber": 171
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 172
          },
          {
            "text": "    let cwd = cli.cwd.clone();",
            "lineNumber": 173
          },
          {
            "text": "    let config_cwd = match cwd.as_deref() {",
            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "text": "        Some(path) =&gt; AbsolutePathBuf::from_absolute_path(path.canonicalize()?)?,",
            "lineNumber": 175
          }

            "text": "param(",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\scripts\\build_and_install.py",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 24
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 265
          }
        },
        "signatures": {
          "ranges": [
            {
              "startPosition": {
                "line": 25,
                "column": 1
              },
              "endPosition": {
                "line": 26,
                "column": 5
              }
            }
          ]
        },
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "class BuildAndInstallSystem:",
            "lineNumber": 25,
            "isSignature": true
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "    def run_command_with_progress(self, cmd: list, description: str, timeout: int = 300) -&gt; bool:",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "        \"\"\"コマンドを実行し、進捗を表示\"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "        print(f\"[TOOL] {description}\")",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "        print(f\"[CMD] コマンド: {' '.join(cmd)}\")",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "        start_time = time.time()",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "        try:",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "            # プログレスバー付きで実行",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "            with tqdm(total=100, desc=f\"⚙️  {description}\", unit=\"%\") as pbar:",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "                process = subprocess.Popen(",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "                    cmd,",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "                    stdout=subprocess.PIPE,",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "                    stderr=subprocess.PIPE,",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "                    text=True,",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "                    cwd=self.codex_rs_dir",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "                )",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "                # 進捗をシミュレートしながら待機",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "                while process.poll() is None:",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "                    time.sleep(0.1)",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "                    # 進捗を少しずつ進める（実際のビルド進捗はわからないので）",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "                    current_progress = min(95, pbar.n + 1)",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "                    pbar.update(current_progress - pbar.n)",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "                # 完了",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "                pbar.update(100 - pbar.n)",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "                stdout, stderr = process.communicate(timeout=timeout)",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "                if process.returncode == 0:",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "                    elapsed = time.time() - start_time",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "                    print(f\"[OK] コマンド成功 ({elapsed:.1f}s)\")",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "                    return True",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "                else:",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "                    print(f\"[ERROR] コマンド失敗 ({time.time() - start_time:.1f}s)\")",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "                    if stderr:",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "                        print(\"エラー出力:\")",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "                        print(stderr)",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "                    return False",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "            print(f\"[TIMEOUT] コマンドがタイムアウトしました ({timeout}s)\")",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "            return False",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "        except Exception as e:",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "            print(f\"[CRASH] コマンド実行エラー: {e}\")",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "            return False",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "    def build_release(self) -&gt; bool:",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "        \"\"\"リリースビルドを実行\"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 86
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.5023156404495239
    },
    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\build_with_progress.py",

          "startPosition": {},
