        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "#!/usr/bin/env python3",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "\"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "Rustビルド進捗可視化スクリプト (tqdm風)",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "高速差分ビルドの進捗を視覚化して残り時間と経過時間を表示",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "\"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "import subprocess",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "import sys",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "import re",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "import time",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "import os",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "from datetime import datetime, timedelta",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "# Windows環境での文字エンコーディング対策",

          {
            "text": "if sys.platform == 'win32':",

          {
            "text": "    import io",

          },
          {
            "text": "    sys.stderr = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stderr.buffer, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "def format_time(seconds):",
            "lineNumber": 21,
            "isSignature": true
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"\"\"秒数を読みやすい形式に変換\"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "    if seconds &lt; 60:",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "        return f\"{seconds:.1f}秒\"",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "    elif seconds &lt; 3600:",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "        minutes = int(seconds // 60)",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "        secs = int(seconds % 60)",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "        return f\"{minutes}分{secs}秒\"",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "    else:",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "        hours = int(seconds // 3600)",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "        minutes = int((seconds % 3600) // 60)",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "        return f\"{hours}時間{minutes}分\"",
            "lineNumber": 32,
            "isSignature": true
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "def parse_cargo_output(line):",

          {

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# ビルド進捗確認スクリプト",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "# tqdm風の進捗表示で残り時間と経過時間を可視化",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "$ErrorActionPreference = \"Continue\"",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "function Show-Progress {",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "    param(",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "        [string]$Message,",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "        [int]$Progress = 0,",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "        [int]$Total = 100,",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "        [double]$ElapsedSeconds = 0,",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "        [double]$EstimatedRemaining = 0",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "    )",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "    $barLength = 50",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "    $filled = [math]::Floor($barLength * $Progress / [math]::Max($Total, 1))",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "    $bar = \"█\" * $filled + \"░\" * ($barLength - $filled)",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "    $percentage = [math]::Min(100, [math]::Floor($Progress * 100 / [math]::Max($Total, 1)))",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "    $elapsedStr = Format-Time $ElapsedSeconds",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "    $remainingStr = if ($EstimatedRemaining -gt 0) { \" | 残り: $(Format-Time $EstimatedRemaining)\" } else { \"\" }",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "    Write-Host \"&#96;r[$bar] $percentage% | $Message | 経過: $elapsedStr$remainingStr\" -NoNewline",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "function Format-Time {",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "    param([double]$Seconds)",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "    if ($Seconds -lt 60) {",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "        return \"{0:F1}秒\" -f $Seconds",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "    } elseif ($Seconds -lt 3600) {",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "        $minutes = [math]::Floor($Seconds / 60)",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "        $secs = [math]::Floor($Seconds % 60)",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "        return \"$minutes分$secs秒\"",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "    } else {",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "        $hours = [math]::Floor($Seconds / 3600)",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "        $minutes = [math]::Floor(($Seconds % 3600) / 60)",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "        return \"$hours時間$minutes分\"",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "function Get-BuildProgress {",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "    $startTime = Get-Date",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 44
          }
        ]

          },

          },

          },

          },

            "text": "            ",

          {

          },
          {

          },

            "text": "Codexビルド進捗可視化スクリプト",

          },
          {

          {
            "text": "\"\"\"",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {

            "text": "import os",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "def run_command_with_progress(cmd, description=\"実行中\"):",
            "lineNumber": 15,
            "isSignature": true
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"\"\"コマンドを実行し、進捗を表示\"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "    print(f\"[START] {description}を開始します...\")",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "    # ダミーのプログレスバー（実際のビルド時間を見積もって）",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "    estimated_steps = 100",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "    with tqdm(total=estimated_steps,",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "              desc=f\"[BUILD] {description}\",",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "              bar_format='{desc}: {percentage:3.0f}%|{bar}| {n_fmt}/{total_fmt} [{elapsed}&lt;{remaining}]') as pbar:",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "        # コマンドを開始",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "        process = subprocess.Popen(",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "            cmd,",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "            shell=True,",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "            text=True,",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "            encoding='utf-8',",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "            cwd=os.path.dirname(__file__)",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "        )",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "        start_time = time.time()",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "        lines_processed = 0",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "        while True:",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "            output = process.stdout.readline()",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "            if output == '' and process.poll() is not None:",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "                break",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "            if output:",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "                # 進捗を更新（出力行数に基づく）",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "                pbar.n = progress",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "                pbar.refresh()",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "                # リアルタイムで出力も表示",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "                print(f\"  &gt; {output.strip()}\")",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "        # 最終進捗",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "        pbar.n = estimated_steps",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "        pbar.refresh()",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "        return_code = process.poll()",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "        if return_code == 0:",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "            print(f\"[SUCCESS] {description}が完了しました！\")",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "            return True",

          },
          {
            "text": "        else:",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "            return False",

          {
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "def main():",
            "lineNumber": 67,
            "isSignature": true

          {
            "text": "    def run_command_with_progress(self, cmd: list, description: str, timeout: int = 300) -&gt; bool:",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "        \"\"\"コマンドを実行し、進捗を表示\"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "        print(f\"[TOOL] {description}\")",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "        print(f\"[CMD] コマンド: {' '.join(cmd)}\")",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "        start_time = time.time()",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "        try:",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "            # プログレスバー付きで実行",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "            with tqdm(total=100, desc=f\"⚙️  {description}\", unit=\"%\") as pbar:",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "                process = subprocess.Popen(",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "                    cmd,",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "                    stdout=subprocess.PIPE,",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "                    stderr=subprocess.PIPE,",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "                    text=True,",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "                    cwd=self.codex_rs_dir",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "                )",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "                # 進捗をシミュレートしながら待機",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "                while process.poll() is None:",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "                    time.sleep(0.1)",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "                    # 進捗を少しずつ進める（実際のビルド進捗はわからないので）",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "                    current_progress = min(95, pbar.n + 1)",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "                    pbar.update(current_progress - pbar.n)",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "                # 完了",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "                pbar.update(100 - pbar.n)",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "                stdout, stderr = process.communicate(timeout=timeout)",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "                if process.returncode == 0:",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "                    elapsed = time.time() - start_time",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "                    print(f\"[OK] コマンド成功 ({elapsed:.1f}s)\")",

          },
          {
            "text": "                    return True",

          },
          {
            "text": "                else:",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "        except Exception as e:",
            "lineNumber": 81

          {

            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {

            "text": "function Draw-ProgressBar {",

          {
            "text": "        [double]$ElapsedSeconds,",

          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 27

          {
            "text": "    $percent = if ($Total -gt 0) { [math]::Round(($Current / $Total) * 100, 1) } else { 0 }",

          },
          {
            "text": "    $barWidth = 40",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "    $filledWidth = [math]::Round(($Current / $Total) * $barWidth)",

          {
            "text": "    ",

          },
          {

          {

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "    $elapsedMin = [math]::Floor($ElapsedSeconds / 60)",

          },
          {
            "text": "    $elapsedSec = [math]::Floor($ElapsedSeconds % 60)",

          },

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Codex Clean Release Build - Progress Display",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "# Created: 2025-10-15",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "param(",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "    [string]$Package = \"codex-cli\"",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": ")",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "function Show-Progress {",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "    param(",

            "text": "        [string]$Activity,",

          },

          },

          },
          {

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {

          {
            "text": "Write-Host \"Step 1/5: Environment Check\" -ForegroundColor Cyan",

          },
          {

          },

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "# Step 3: Build with progress",

          },

          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "Write-Host \"\"",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "$buildStart = Get-Date",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "$buildLog = \"..\\build-progress-$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss').log\"",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "# Start build job",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "$buildJob = Start-Job -ScriptBlock {",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "    param($pkg, $logFile, $workDir)",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "    Set-Location $workDir",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "    cargo build --release -p $pkg 2&gt;&amp;1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $logFile",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "} -ArgumentList $Package, $buildLog, (Get-Location).Path",
            "lineNumber": 64
          }

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "class BuildManager:",

          {

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 374
          },
          {
            "text": "                lines_processed = 0",

          },
          {
            "text": "                with tqdm(desc=description, unit=\"lines\") as pbar:",
            "lineNumber": 376
          },
          {
            "text": "                    for line in process.stdout:",
            "lineNumber": 377
          },
          {
            "text": "                        lines_processed += 1",

          },
          {
            "text": "                        pbar.update(1)",
            "lineNumber": 379
          },
          {
            "text": "                        if lines_processed % 10 == 0:  # Update description occasionally",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 382
          },
          {
            "text": "                        if self.config.verbose:",

          },
          {
            "text": "                            print(line.rstrip())",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 385
          },
          {
            "text": "                return process.wait() == 0",

          },
          {
            "text": "            else:",

          },
          {
            "text": "                # Run without progress bar",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "                    cmd,",

          },
          {
            "text": "                    capture_output=not self.config.verbose,",
            "lineNumber": 391
          },
          {
            "text": "                    text=True,",
            "lineNumber": 392
          },
          {
            "text": "                    env=env or os.environ,",
            "lineNumber": 393
          },
          {
            "text": "                    cwd=self.config.project_root",
            "lineNumber": 394
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 396
          },
          {
            "text": "                if self.config.verbose:",
            "lineNumber": 397
          },
          {
            "text": "                    if result.stdout:",
            "lineNumber": 398
          },
          {
            "text": "                        print(result.stdout)",
            "lineNumber": 399
          },
          {
            "text": "                    if result.stderr:",
            "lineNumber": 400
          },
          {
            "text": "                        print(result.stderr)",
            "lineNumber": 401
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 402
          },
          {
            "text": "                return result.returncode == 0",
            "lineNumber": 403
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 404
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 405
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "            return False",

          },

          },
          {

          },

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\scripts\\monitor-build.py",
        "range": {

        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "#!/usr/bin/env python3",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "\"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "Cargo Build Progress Monitor with tqdm-style visualization",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "カーゴビルド進捗モニター（tqdm風視覚化）",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "\"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "import subprocess",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "import re",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "import time",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "from datetime import datetime, timedelta",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "def monitor_cargo_build():",
            "lineNumber": 12,
            "isSignature": true
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"\"\"Monitor cargo build output and display progress\"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "    print(\"🚀 Codex 1.0.0 Release Build Monitor\")",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "    print(\"=\" * 60)",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "    start_time = datetime.now()",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "    total_crates = 0",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "    compiled_crates = 0",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "    current_crate = \"\"",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "    ",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "    # Pattern: \"Compiling crate-name v1.0.0 (...)\"",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "    compile_pattern = re.compile(r'^\\s+Compiling\\s+(.+?)\\s+v[\\d.]+')",
            "lineNumber": 24

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📋 問題サマリー",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "Codex MCP Server のビルド時に以下のエラーが発生：",
            "lineNumber": 11

          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",

          },

            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🔍 根本原因分析",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "### 問題の特定",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "| 項目 | 期待値 | 実際の値 | 問題 |",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "|------|--------|---------|------|",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "| **Rustバージョン** | 1.90.0 (rust-toolchain.toml) | 1.92.0-nightly | ❌ 不一致 |",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "| **ツールチェーン** | stable | nightly | ❌ 不一致 |",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "| **CPUターゲット** | 汎用 | 最適化（AVX2等） | ❌ 命令セット不一致 |",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "### エラーの原因",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **ツールチェーンの不一致**",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;rust-toolchain.toml&#96; で 1.90.0 を指定",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "   - 実際には nightly (1.92.0) が使用されていた",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "   - nightly の最適化が CPU と不一致",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **CPU命令セットの問題**",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;bstr&#96; クレートが AVX/AVX2 命令を使用",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "   - CPUまたはエミュレーション環境が対応していない",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;STATUS_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION&#96; エラー発生",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🔧 修正手順",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "### ステップ1: Rustバージョンの固定",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "cd codex-rs",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "rustup override set 1.90.0",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "**結果**:",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "info: override toolchain for 'C:\\...\\codex-rs' set to '1.90.0-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc'",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "✅ ツールチェーンを stable 1.90.0 に固定成功",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "### ステップ2: バージョン確認",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "rustc --version",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "**結果**:",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "rustc 1.90.0 (1159e78c4 2025-09-14)",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "✅ 正しいバージョンが適用された",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "### ステップ3: CPUターゲットを指定してビルド",

            "text": "$env:RUSTFLAGS = \"-C target-cpu=x86-64\"",

          {
            "text": "cargo build --release -p codex-mcp-server",

          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",

          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 296
          },
          {
